text: Lo luns, los cientificos d'a facultat de medicina d'a Universidat de Stanford anuncioron l'invento d'una nueva ferramienta de diagnostico que puede catalogar las celulas seguntes lo suyo tipo: un chip chicotet que se puede imprentar y fabricar con impresoras d'inchección d'uso corrient, per un posible coste de, aproximadament, un centimo de dólar cadaún.

text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Lo comisionau fixa la cantidat d'a fianza, si les n'apreba, y formaliza los cargos presentaus per l'oficial que procede a la suya detención. Los mesmos s'introducen, contino, en o sistema informatico de l'estau, a traviés d'o cual se fa lo seguimiento d'o caso.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Las manifestacions se facioron, amás, en París; Sofía, Bulgaria; Vilnius, Lituania; Valetta, Malta; Tallinn, Estonia y Edimburgo y Glasgow, Escocia.
text_en: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

text: En Londres, bellas 200 personas se manifestoron difuera d'as oficinas de beluns d'os propietarios de dreitos d'autor mas importants.
text_en: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

text: Lo mes pasau, se celebroron importants manifestacions en Polonia cuan lo país sinyó l'ACTA, lo cual causó que lo gubierno polaco decidise no ratificar l'acuerdo, per agora.
text_en: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

text: Tanto Letonia como Eslovaquia han apolargau lo procedimiento d'unión a l'ACTA.
text_en: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

text: Lo movimiento Liberación Animal y la Reyal Sociedat pa la Prevención d'a Crueldat cuentra los Animals (RSPCA) nuevament reclaman la instalación obligatoria de camaras de videovichilancia en toz los mataders d'Australia.
text_en: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: David, U'Shannessy, chefe d'inspección d'a RSPCA de Nueva Gales d'o Sud, afirmó a ABC que en Australia habría d'estar bella cosa normal sozmeter a vichilancia y a inspeccions a los mataders.
text_en: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text: «En instalar un circuito zarrau de televisión, regular que se ninviará un mensache contundent a qui treballan con animals de que lo suyo buen pasar ye de maxima prioridat».
text_en: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: Lo mapa internacional de tierratrémols d'o Servicio Cheolochico d'EUA no amostró movimientos sismicos en Islandia la semana anterior.
text_en: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

text: Tampoco la Oficina Meteorolochica d'Islandia reportó actividat sismica en Hekla mientres las pasadas 48 horas.
text_en: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: Los movimientos sismicos de gran magnitut que causoron lo cambio de fase ocurrioron lo 10 de marzo, en o sector nordeste d'a caldera que se troba en a tuca d'este volcán.
text_en: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

text: Se rechistroron boiras foscas en a base d'a montanya que no tiene relación con garra actividat volcanica.
text_en: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: Las boiras podeban causar confusión sobre si de verdat i heba habiu una erupción.
text_en: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: Cuan se produció l'avería, lo Luno levaba 120-160 metros cubicos de combustible a bordo y l'airera fuerte y las olas l'arrocegoron cuentra la escollera.
text_en: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: Los helicopters rescatoron a los doce miembros d'a tripulación, y la sola lesión estió una nariz trencada.
text_en: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: Lo barco de 100 metros yera en rota pa replegar la suya carga habitual de fertilizants y, en un comienzo, i heba preocupación entre los funcionarios per si bella carga se podese redamar.
text_en: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: Las dos cambras apreboron la esmienda proposada en 2011.
text_en: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: En esta sesión parlamentaria s'introdució una modificación cuan la Cambra de Representants n'eliminó la segunda oración y, posteriorment, lo luns, lo Senau l'aprebó con una redacción semellant.
text_en: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: Existe la posibilidat de que la eliminación d'a segunda oración, que proposa vetar las unions civils entre individuos d'o mesmo sexo, les ubra lo paso en o futuro.
text_en: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: Dimpués d'o proceso, HJR-3 será examinau unatra vegada per la nueva lechislatura electa, en 2015 u 2016.
text_en: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: Los exitos de Vautier, sin contar con o suyo paper de director, incluyen una vaca de fambre en 1973 pa luitar cuentra lo que él entendeba como censura politica.
text_en: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: La lei francesa se cambió. S'inició como activista a la edat de 15 anyos, en integrar-se en a Resistencia francesa mientres la Segunda Guerra Mundial.
text_en: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: Escribió un libro autobiografico en 1998.
text_en: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: En a decada de 1960, tornó ta Alcheria, que heba aconseguiu feba poco la suya independencia, pa dar clases de dirección cinematografica.
text_en: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: Lo judoca naixiu de Chapón, Hitoshi Saito, portador de dos medallas olimpicas d'oro, feneixió a los 54 anyos.
text_en: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: Se comunicó que la causa d'a suya muerte estió cáncer de conductos biliars intrahepaticos.
text_en: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: La suya muerte ocurrió lo martes, en Osaka.
text_en: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: A la data d'a suya muerte, amás d'haber estau medallista olimpico y mundial, Saito yera director d'o comité d'entrenamiento d'a Federación de Judo chaponesa.
text_en: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: No menos de 100 convidaus heban concurriu a la fiesta con a finalidat de celebrar lo primer aniversario d'a parella, que la suya voda s'heba celebrau un anyo antes.
text_en: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Las autoridaz informoron que s'heba programau un evento formal d'aniversario pa unatra data posterior.
text_en: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: La parella heba contraito matrimonio en Texas un anyo antes y vinió ta Buffalo pa celebrar-lo con os suyos amigos y familiars.
text_en: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: Lo conchuche, de 30 anyos y naixiu de Buffalo, estió un d'os cuatro muertos en o tiroteyo, pero la suya esposa no sufrió feridas.
text_en: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno ye un profesor d'anglés reconoixiu, encara que controvertiu, que amostró en Modern Education y en King's Glory y que aseguró haber teniu 9.000 estudiants en a tuca d'a suya carrera.
text_en: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: En as notas emplegaba parolas consideradas groseras en bels países y, d'acuerdo con os informes, emplegó amás malas parolas meintres las clases.
text_en: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Modern Education l'acusó de publicar grans anuncios publicitarios en os autobuses sin autorización y de mentir decindo que yera l'instructor principal d'anglés.
text_en: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Tamién se le heba acusau en o pasau de violar dreitos d'autor, pero no se presentoron cargos cuentra él.
text_en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Un antigo estudiant dició que l'hombre «emplegaba un argot en as clases, amostraba con apunts habilidaz pa citas y actuaba como si fuese un amigo d'os alumnos».
text_en: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: En as tres zagueras decadas, China ha desenrollau una economía de mercau, encara que, oficialment, contina tenendo un rechimen comunista.
text_en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Baixo lo mando de Deng Xiaoping se facioron las primeras reformas economicas.
text_en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: D'allí enta debant, lo volumen economico de China ha creixiu en un factor 90.
text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: La exportación d'autos de China superó, per primer vegada, a la d'Alemanya y sobreixió a EUA como lo mercau mas important d'esta industria.
text_en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: En vinte anyos, lo PIB de China podría estar mas alto que lo d'os Estaus Unius.
text_en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: En a temporada d'huracans en l'Atlantico de 2010, Danielle ye la cuarta tempesta tropical en estar nombrada y s'orichinó en a parte oriental d'o dito oceano.
text_en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: La tempesta, localizada a bellas 3.000 millas de Miami, Florida, presenta vientos que alcanzan una velocidat maxima constant de 40 mph (64 km/h).
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Los expertos d'o Centro Nacional d'Huracans preveyen que Danielle s'intensificará y desencadenará un huracán lo mierques venient.
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Dau que la tronada ye luent de tocar tierra, encara ye difícil d'avaluar lo potencial impacto que tendrá en os Estaus Unius u en o Caribe.
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Bobek, naixiu de Zagreb, capital de Croacia, ganó popularidat cuan s'unió a lo Partizan de Belgrado.
text_en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: En 1945 i dentró y se i quedó dica 1958.
text_en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: En o suyo paso per lo club, ponió 403 gols en 468 partius.
text_en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Garra atro chugador no ha feito mas aparicions u anotau mas gols en favor d'o club que Bobek.
text_en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Estió triau como lo millor futbolista d'a historia d'o Partizan en 1995.
text_en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Las celebracions encomenzoron con un espectaclo especial feito per lo globalment famoso Cirque du Soleil.
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Dimpués se presentó la Orquesta Sinfonica d'o Estau d'Estambul, un grupo de Janissary y Fatih Erkoç y Müslüm Gürses, los dos cantantes.
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Dimpués, Whirling Derviches fació la suya aparición en o escenario.
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: La diva turca Sezen Aksu cantó con Alessandro Safina, un tenor italiano, y con a cantante griega Haris Alexiou.
text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Pa rematar, lo grupo de danza turco Anatolia interpretó «Troya».
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, un corredor de motocicletas de 13 anyos, ha muerto dimpués de participar en un accident en o circuito d'Indianapolis.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Minetrs feba la vuelta de calentamiento Lenz se cayió d'a suya moto y estió dimpués atropellau per lo suyo companyero, Xavier Zayat.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Recibió atención medica immediata en a pista y estió tresladau ta un hespital local, an que feneixió mas tarde.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat no resultó feriu en l'accident.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Zapatero continó decindo, en o que toca a la situación financiera a nivel mundial, que «lo sistema financiero ye una part d'a economía, que tiene una importancia clara.
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Somos vivindo una crisi economica dende fa un anyo, y los dos zaguers meses han estau los piors. Considero que, actualment, los mercaus financiers han encomenzau la suya recuperación».
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: La semana pasada, Naked News (Noticias espulladas) fació saber publicament que aumentaría considerablement lo suyo compromís con as noticias en idiomas internacionals, con tres nuevos programas.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Esta organización global, que ya da las noticias en anglés y en chaponés, ye activando programas en espanyol, italiano y coreano pa la televisión, internet y dispositivos móbils.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Per suerte, soi bien, pero presencié una escena macabra cuan la chent miraba de trencar las finestras pa escapar.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Tot y que las personas trucaban los vidres con siellas, las finestras yeran imposibles de trencar.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: Un sobrevivient, Franciszek Kowal, «contó que un d'os panels de vidre finalment se trencó y prencipioron a fuyir per la finestra».
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: La luz y la calor que dimana d'as estrelas se chenera cuan s'unen (u fusionan) los atomos d'hidrógeno pa formar elementos mas pesaus.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Los cientificos concentran lo suyo treballo en desenvolver un reactor capaz de chenerar enerchía d'a mesma forma.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Con tot y con ixo, ye un problema de mal solucionar y no será fesable la construcción de reactors de fusión útils dica que no pasen muitos anyos.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: La tensión superficial prevoca que l'agulla se quede flotando sobre l'augua.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: La tensión superficial se produz a causa que las moleculas d'augua en a suya superficie s'atrayen con muita mas intensidat que las moleculas d'aire que son per dencima d'ellas.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Las moleculas d'augua forman una cinta invisible sobre la suya superficie que permite que obchectos como las agullas floten dencima d'ella.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: La fuella d'os patins de chelo modernos tien un filo de dos cantos separaus per un espacio concavo entre éls, lo cual permite una millor adherencia a lo chelo, mesmo cuan ye abocada.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Como la parte inferior d'a fuella ye lieument curvada, en inclinar-la enta un costau u l'atro, lo canto que queda en contacto con o chelo tamién se curva.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Esto fa que lo patinador chire. Cuan los patins s'inclinan enta la dreita, lo patinador tamién chira en ixa dirección; si lo fan enta la zurda, chirará enta la zurda.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Pa recuperar lo nivel d'enerchía anterior, s'han de desfer d'a enerchía adicional que han recibiu d'a luz.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Se fa en emitir una chicota particla de luz clamada «fotón».
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Los expertos claman a este proceso «emisión estimulada de radiación», ya que la luz brilant estimula los atomos, lo cual chenera la emisión d'un fotón de luz, que ye una mena de radiación.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: En a imachen que sigue s'ilustran atomos que emiten fotons. Prou que estes son, en verdat, muito mas chicoz que los d'a imachen.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Los fotons son mesmo mas chicoz que la materia que fa part d'os atomos!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Dimpués de funcionar per cientos d'horas, lo filamento d'a bombilla s'acaba cremando y esta deixa de funcionar.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Dimpués, s'ha de cambiar la bombilla. S'ha de parar cuenta cuan en cambiar la bombilla.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Lo primero que s'ha de fer ye amortar l'interruptor d'a lampa u desconectar-ne lo cordón.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Esto ye asinas perque la electricidat que corre enta la boquiella an que se fica la part metalica d'a bombilla puede causar una descarga electrica grieu si se toca l'interior d'ixa boquiella u la base de metal d'a bombilla mientres encara ye parcialment en a boquiella.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Lo corazón, que pompeya la sangre, ye l'organo mas important d'o sistema circulatorio.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: La sangre fluye dende lo corazón a traviés d'unas vías clamadas arterias y torna ta este per atras denominadas venas. Los conductos mas chicoz se dicen capilars.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Con a suya dentadura, un tricerátops habría puesto capolar no nomás fuellas, sino tamién brancas y radices muito duras.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Seguntes creyen cualques cientificos, l'alimentación d'o Tricerátops yera a pur de cicadas, una mena de planta común en o periodo Cretacico.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Estas plantas se pareixen a una chicota palmera con una corona de fuellas filosas y punchigudas.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Lo Triceráptors podría haber rancau las fuellas con o suyo fortal cuerno en cuenta de minchar-se-ne la zoca.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Atros cientificos afirman que son pocas las probabilidaz de que bel dinosaurio s'alimentase con estas plantas, ya que son altament verenosas; manimenos, en l'actualidat, lo perezoso y atras especies, como lo loro (que descienden d'os dinosaurios), pueden minchar fuellas u fruitos verenosos.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Qué efecto tendría en yo la gravedat de Ío? Si vusté se trobase en a superficie d'o satelite, lo suyo peso sería menor que en a Tierra.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Belún que en a Tierra pese 200 libras (90 kg) en Ío pesaría bellas 36 libras (16 kg). Ixo significa, ye claro, que la suya gravedat exerce menos atracción.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Lo Sol no tien una crosta como la Tierra, sobre la cual uno se i pueda estar de piet. Ye composau completament per gases, fuego y plasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: A mesura que pierde proximidat con o sol, lo gas se torna mas luchero.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: La part externa que podemos observar cuan mirarmos enta lo Sol se diz fotosfera; esto ye, «esfera de luz».
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Bels tres mil anyos dimpués, en 1610, l'astronomo italiano, Galileo Galilei, podió observar, a traviés d'o telescopio, que Venus teneba fases, como las que tien la luna.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Las fases se producen perque nomás s'ilumina la cara de Venus (u d'a Luna) que mira enta lo sol. Este fenomeno refirmó la teoría copernicana que las planetas orbitan alredol d'o sol.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Posteriorment, en 1639, Jeremiah Horrocks, un astronomo anglés,  aconsiguió veyer un transito de Venus.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Dimpués de reconquerir Danelaw, Anglaterra vivió un prolongau periodo de paz.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Manimenos, en 991, Ethelred luitó cuentra la flota vikinga mas gran dende la de Guthrum, un sieglo antes.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Olaf Trygvasson, un noruego con ambición de recuperar la suya nación d'o dominio danés, yera lo líder d'a flota.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Dimpués de concarar los inicials contratiempos militars, Ethelred aconsiguió arribar a un acuerdo con Olaf, qui tornó ta Noruega pa intentar ganar lo suyo reino, con resultaus dispars.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: L'alfabeto coreano ye lo solo disenyau en forma deliberada que encara se fa servir a diario popularment. S'inventó en 1444, mientres lo reinau de Sejong (1418 a 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Sejong estió lo cuarto monarca d'a dinastía Joseon y un d'os que ganó mayor respeto.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Lo nombre orichinal que se le dio a l'alfabeto Hangeul estió Hunmin Jeongeum, que significa «los sons adecuaus pa la instrucción d'o pueblo ».
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Existen numbrosas teorías sobre cómo plegó a existir lo sanscrito. Una d'ellas fabla d'una migración aria dende l'ueste enta la India, que trayió con éls l'idioma.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: La luenga sanscrita ye antiga, comparable a lo latín charrau en Europa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Lo primer libro d'o cual se'n tien conoixencia estió redactau en sanscrito. Dimpués d'a compilación d'Upanishads, este idioma simplament desapareixió, per cuestions de hierarquía.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Lo sanscrito ye un idioma complexo y rico que estió la fuent de muitas atras luengas modernas d'a India, asinas como lo latín ye fuent de luengas europeas, como lo francés y lo espanyol.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: En rematar la batalla per Francia, Alemanya empecipió a planificar la invasión d'a isla de Gran Bretanya.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Alemanya asignó a l'ataque lo nombre en clau de «Operación Lobo Marino». L'exercito britanico yera pro feble, ya que heba perdiu la mayoría d'as armas pesadas y los suministros mientres la suya evacuación de Dunkerque.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Pero la Marina Reyal encara yera muito mas fuerte que l'alemana (Kriegsmarine) y podría haber destruyiu a cualsequier flota invasora que mirase de dentrar per la Canal d'a Manga.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Con tot y con ixo, yeran bien pocas las bases d'os vaixiellos d'a Marina Reyal que s'ubicaban cerca d'as posibles rotas d'invasión, ya que los almirants temeban que l'ataque aerio alemán los fundise.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Encomencemos explicando los plans d'Italia. Basicament, Italia yera lo «chirmano chicot» d'Alemanya y Chapón.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Lo suyo exercito y marina yeran mas febles, encara que cuatro barcos nuevos s'acababan de construyir chusto antes de l'inicio d'a guerra.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Italia teneba como obchectivo primordial a los países africanos. Pa capturar-los, le faría falta una plataforma de lanzamiento de tropas pa que estas podesen navegar per la Mar Mediterrania y, asinas, invadir Africa.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Pa ixo, s'habioron de desfer d'as bases y los barcos britanicos localizaus en Echipto. Se suposaba que, amás d'ixas accions, los acorazaus italianos no heban de fer cosa mas.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Agora, Chapón. Este ye un país insular, como Gran Bretanya.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Los submarinos son naus disenyadas pa desplazar y quedar-se per debaixo de l'augua per un largo periodo de tiempo.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Entre la Primera y la Segunda Guerra Mundial se facioron servir submarinos. Alavez, yeran muito lentos y lo suyo alcanz de tiro yera muito limitau.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: A l'inicio d'a guerra, viachiaban mas que mas per la superficie d'o mar, pero, a mesura que se desenrollaron los radars y estes adquirioron mayor precisión, los submarinos se veyioron aforzaus a meter-se baixo l'augua pa no estar detectaus.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Los submarinos alemans se clamoron U-Boote. Los alemans yeran muito buenos pa fer navegar y pa operar los suyos submarinos.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Dimpués d'o suyo exito con os submarinos, dende que remató la guerra no chenera confianza que los alemans tiengan guaires cantidaz d'esta mena de naus.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Sí! Uno d'os reis mas conoixius de l'antigo Echipto en o mundo moderno ye lo rei Tutankamón, a vegadas clamau «rei Tut» u «lo nino rei».
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Curiosament, en l'antiguidat no se le consideraba como de guaire importancia y en a mas gran parte d'as listas d'os reis antigos no yera rechistrau.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Manimenos, se tornó famoso dimpués d'o descubrimiento d'a suya fuesa en 1922. Mientres que muitos sepulcres antigos heban estau saquiaus, lo de Tutankamón seguiba cuasi intacto.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: La mayoría d'os obchectos que estioron enterrecaus con Tutankamón s'han conservau en buen estau, entre éls, mils d'artefactos elaboraus con metals preciosos y piedras exoticas.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: La invención d'a rueda de rayos convirtió los carros asirios en vehíclos mas liuchers, rapidos y millor preparaus pa deixar dezaga a los soldaus y atros carros.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Las letals flechas d'as ballestas podeban penetrar l'armadura d'os soldaus enemigos. Alredol de l'anyo 1000 a. de C., los asirios introducioron la caballería per primer vegada.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Una caballería ye una fuerza de combat que luita amontada a caballo. En ixas envueltas, encara no existiban las monturas; la caballería asiria batalló sobre los lomos espullaus d'os equinos.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Conoixemos a numbrosos politicos, hombres de ciencia y artistas griegos. Ye probable que la figura mas famosa d'esta cultura sía Homero, lo proverbial poeta ciego escritor de dos poemas, obras mayestras d'a literatura griega: la Iliada y la Odisea.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sofocles y Aristofanes continan estando celebres escritors d'obras de teatro y los suyos treballos se consideran d'os millors d'a literatura mundial.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Unatra figura griega de renombre ye Pitagoras, matematico conoixiu mas que mas a causa d'o suyo famoso teorema sobre la relación entre los costaus d'os trianglos rectanglos.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: S'han feito cuantas estimacions sobre lo numero de parladors de l'hindi. Se calcula que ye entre lo segundo y cuarto idioma que mas cantidat de personas charran en o mundo.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: La cantidat de fablants nativos será diferent seguntes se computen u no dialectos que sían muito relacionaus entre éls.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Diferents calculos estiman que existen entre 340 y 500 millons de personas que charran l'idioma y dica 800 millons que pueden entender-lo.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Encara que son semellants cuanto a lo vocabulario, l'hindi y l'urdu difieren en a forma d'escribir-se. En as conversas de toz los días, los parladros d'os dos idiomas pueden, per un regular, entender-sen entre éls.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: La cultura alemana exerceba una marcada influencia en o norte d'Estonia ta allá ta lo sieglo XV.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Cualques monches d'Alemanya quereban acercar a Dios a la chent nativa a Dios, per lo cual s'inventoron la luenga escrita estonia.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: La suya base estió l'alfabeto alemán y se i anyadió un carácter: «Õ/õ».
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Con o paso d'o tiempo, muitas parolas presas de l'alemán se fusionoron. Esto marcó l'inicio d'a Ilustración.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Ye tradición que lo futuro sucesor d'o trono vaiga directament ta l'exercito dimpués de rematar la suya educación escolar.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Manimenos, Charles asistió a la universidat en Trinity College, Cambridge. Allí estudió antropolochía y arqueolochía y, tiempo dimpués, historia, recibindo un 2:2 (un títol inferior de segunda clase).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles estió lo primer miembro d'a familia reyal britanica en obtener un títol universitario.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: La Turquía europea (Tracia Oriental u Rumelia, en a peninsula d'os Balcans) comprende lo 3 % d'o país.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Lo territorio de Turquía tien mas de 1.600 kilometros de largaria (1.000 millas), 800 km d'amplaria (500 millas) y tien una forma si fa u no fa rectangular.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: La superficie de Turquía, incluyius los lagos, ocupa 783.562 kilometros cuadraus, d'os cuals 755.688 se troban en o sudueste d'Asia y 23.764 en Europa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: La superficie de Turquía fa que sía en o puesto 37 d'os países mas grans d'o globo, con una grandaria pareixida a la d'a Francia metropolitana y lo Reino Uniu chuntos.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Tres d'os costaus de Turquía son rodiaus per mars: l'ueste, per la Mar Echea; lo norte, per la Mar Negra y lo sud, per la Mediterrania.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Si bien Luxemburgo tien una larga historia, la suya independencia no ocurrió dica l'anyo 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: En o pasau, bellas partes actuals de Belchica perteneixeban a Luxemburgo, pero, dimpués d'a Revolución belga d'a decada de 1830, se tornoron belgas.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxemburgo siempre ha mirau de mantener-se como un estau neutral; manimenos, Alemanya l'invadió en as dos guerras mundials.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Luxemburgo pasó a estar, en 1957, miembro fundador d'o que hue clamamos Unión Europea.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Lo Drukgyal Dzong ye una fortificación y monesterio budista deteriorau que se troba en o norte d'o distrito de Paro, en Phondey Village.
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Seguntes cuenta la historia, en 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel construyió la fuerza con o proposito de commemorar lo suyo triunfo cuentra l'exercito tibetano-mongol.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Lo retrato de Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal ye una d'as pocas reliquias que han quedau d'o Drukgyal Dzong, a consecuencia d'un incendio ocurriu en 1951.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Dimpués de l'incendio, se preservó y se dio protección a la fuerza, que mantiene lo suyo puesto como una d'as atraccions mas impresionants de Bhután.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: En o sieglo XVIII lo Reino de Cambocha quedó acorralau entre dos poderosos vecins, Tailandia y Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Mientres lo sieglo XVIII, Cambocha sufrió cuantas invasions d'os tailandeses, qui, en 1772, destruyioron Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: En zaguerías d'o sieglo XVIII, Cambocha tamién sufrió invasions vietnamitas.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Lo deciueito per ciento d'os venezolanos no tien emplego y la mayor parte de qui sí lo tienen, treballan en a informalidat.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Dos tercios d'os treballadors venezolanos treballan en o sector servicios, alredol d'una cuarta parte treballa en a industria y una cinquena parte, en o sector agricola.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: En Venezuela lo petrolio ye una industria important, en a cual lo país ye un exportador neto, encara que nomás l'1% d'a suya población treballa en este sector.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Dimpués que la nación declaró la suya independencia, los expertos d'os Chardins Botanicos de Singapur aduyoron a transformar la isla en una ciudat chardín tropical.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: En 1981, s'eslichió la orquidia de Singapur, que ye un cautivo hibrido, como la flor nacional.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Toz los anyos, ta allá ta octubre, aproximadament 1,5 millons d'herbivoros emigran enta las tierras planas d'o sud, trescruzando lo río Mara, dende las colinas d'o norte, en busca d'as plevidas.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Y dimpués, tornan ta lo norte per l'ueste, trescruzando nuevament lo río Mara, malas que rematan las plevidas, ta allá ta abril.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: En a rechión d'o Serengeti se troba lo Parque Nacional d'o Serengeti, la Zona de Conservación de Ngorongoro y la Reserva de Caza Maswa, totas ellas en Tanzania. En Kenya se localiza la Reserva Nacional Massai Mara.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Aprender a crear medios interactivos implica contar con habilidaz convencionals y tradicionals, amás d'o dominio de ferramientas en clases interactivas (guión grafico, edición d'audio y video, narrativa, etc.).
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Lo disenyo interactivo requiere que vusté reconsidere las suyas conchecturas sobre la producción de medios y que desenrolle un pensamiento no linial.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Lo disenyo interactivo requiere que los components d'un prochecto se connecten un con l'atro, pero que de vez conserven lo suyo sentiu como entidaz deseparadas.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: L'aspecto negativo d'os obchectivos con zoom ye que la complexidat focal y la cantidat d'elementos d'obchectivo que se precisan pa aconseguir un rango de distancias focals ye muito mayor que los que fan falta pa los obchectivos fixos.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Este problema cada vegada ye menos important gracias a que los fabricants de lents aconsiguen estándards mas altos en a suya producción.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Esto ha feito posible que los obchectivos con zoom produzcan fotografías d'una calidat comparable a la que s'aconsigue con os de focal fixa.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Unatra desavantacha d'as lents con zoom ye que la maxima obridura (la velocidat) d'a lente goesa estar, per un regular, mas chicota.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Esto fa que las lentes con zoom economicas no sían de buen utilizar en condicions de poca luz u sin flash.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Un d'os problemas mas comuns cuan se mira de convertir una cinta a DVD ye la sobreexploración.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Lo disenyo d'a mayoría d'as televisions tien como obchetivo complacer a lo publico cheneral.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Ye este lo motivo per lo cual totas las imachens que veye en a televisión amaneixen con os cantos superior, inferior y laterals tallaus.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Esto se fa pa garantizar que la imachen se desplegue en a pantalla completa. Esto se denomina sobreexploración.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Lamentablement, en creyar un DVD, ye muito probable que los cantos queden retallaus y, si lo video tien subtítulos cerca d'a marguin inferior, no se veyerán completos.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Lo castiello tipico medieval ha serviu d'inspiración per muito tiempo a la imachinación y evoca imáchens de chustas, banquez y caballería arturica.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Encara aturaus en bel meyo d'enruenas milenarias, ye fácil evocar los sons y las olors d'as batallas que ocurrioron fa muito tiempo; cuasi se puede sentir l'impacto d'os cascos en os adoquins y sentir la olor d'o espanto que puyaba dende las matmorras.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Pero, la nuestra imachinación ye basada en a realidat? Cuál estió lo motivo, pa empecipiar, per lo cual se construyioron castiellos? Qué metodo s'emplegó pa disenyar-los y construyir-los?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Lo clamau castiello de Kirby Muxloe no ye tal, sino, mas bien, una casa fortificada, cosa tipica d'ixa epoca.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Las suyas grans finestras de cristal y los suyos primos muros no podrían haber resistiu un ataque decidiu per masiau tiempo.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: En a decada de 1480, cuan Lord Hastings empecipió la suya edificación, lo país yera prou pacifico y nomás feba falta defensa cuentra chicotas clicas de delincuents dondiadors.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: L'equilibrio de poder yera un sistema a traviés d'o cual los países europeus procuraban que se mantenese la sobiranía nacional de cadaún d'os estaus d'ixe continent.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Los gubiernos nacionals gosaban cambiaban las suyas alianzas con a finalidat de mantener l'equilibrio, ya que compartiban lo concepto que totas las nacions europeas heban de procurar privar que nomás una nación se fese poderosa.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: La Guerra de Sucesión d'Espanya estió la primera que lo suyo obcheto principal estió l'equilibrio de poder.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Esto delimitó un cambio de gran importancia, dau que las potencias europeas no tendrían la enchaquia de que se trataba d'enfrontinamientos d'indoli relichiosa. Per ixo, la guerra d'os Trenta Anyos sería la zaguera en catalogarse como guerra relichiosa.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Lo 21 de chuliol de l'anyo 356 a. de C. se destruyió lo templo d'Artemisa en Efeso, en un incendio premeditau causau per Herostratus.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Seguntes la historia, la suya motivación yera aconseguir la fama a cualsequier pre y que los efesios, indignaus per ixo, anuncioron que nunca no se rechistraría lo nombre d'Herostrato.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Lo griego Estrabón, erudito en historia, apuntó lo suyo nombre mas enta debant, que ye lo que hue conoixemos. Lo templo s'espaldó la mesma nueit en que naixió Alejandro Magno.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alejandro, como rei, ufrió pagar la reconstrucción d'o templo, pero refusoron la suya propuesta. Mas tarde, dimpués d'a suya muerte, lo templo estió reconstruyiu en 323 a. de C.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Asegure-se que la suya man sía tant relaixada como sía posible mientres sigue tocando las notas de forma correcta. Amás, prebe de no fer guaires movimientos raros con os suyos didos.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Asinas, se cansará lo menos posible. Tienga present que, a diferencia d'o piano, no fa falta pretar masiau fuerte las teclas pa obtener un mayor volumen.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Si vusté deseya puyar lo volumen tanyendo la curdión, ha de fer servir la mancha con mas presión u velocidat.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Lo misticismo consiste en mirar lo vinclo, la identidat u la reconoixencia conscient d'una realidat suprema, divinidat, verdat immaterial u Dios.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Lo deseyo d'o creyent ye una experiencia directa, sensación u apreciación d'a realidat divina, d'o dios u d'as deidaz.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Los suyos adeptos se proposan adoptar bellas formas de vida u practicas con l'obchectivo de nutrir ixas experiencias.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Lo misticismo puede diferenciar-se d'atros tipos de creyencias y cultos relichiosos per la suyo enfasi en a experiencia personal directa d'un solo estau de consciencia, en concreto, aquels de carácter pacifico, sagaz, goyoso u mesmo euforico.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Lo sijismo ye un culto relichioso proveniente d'o subcontinent indio. Naixió en o sieglo XV en a zona de Punjab, producto d'una división sectaria dentro de l'hinduismo.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Los sijs tienen la convicción de que lo suya credo constituye una relichión desligada de l'hinduismo, pero reconoixen los suyos orichens y tradicions hindús.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Los sijs denominan Gurmat a la suya relichión, que, en punjabi, quiere decir «camín d'o gurú». Lo gurú ye un aspecto esencial de totas las relichions indias, pero, en o sijismo, ha cobrau una importancia que conforma l'eixe d'as creyencias sij.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Guru Nank (1469- 1569) fundó la relichión en o sieglo XV y le siguioron, de forma sucesiva, atros nueu gurús.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Manimenos, en chunyo de 1956, se metioron a preba las promesas de Krushchev, cuan los disturbios en Polonia encabezaus per treballadors que protestaban per la falta d'alimentos y las reduccions salarials, derivoron en una manifestación cheneralizada cuentra lo comunismo.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Tot y que Hruixchov ninvió a la fin tanques con l'obchectivo de restablir l'orden, de vez cedió a cualques d'as exichencias de tipo economico y accedió a nombrar a lo popular Wladyslaw Gomulka como lo nuevo primer ministro.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: La civilización d'a val de l'Indo se desenvolvió en a Edat d'o Bronce, en o subcontinent d'o nordueste d'a India, que comprende la mayor parte d'o territorio hue pakistaní y cualques zonas d'o nordueste indio y lo nordeste afgano.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: La civilización amaneixió en a cuenca d'o río Indo, d'o cual proviene lo suyo nombre.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Con tot y con ixo, cualques expertos estiman que, a causa de que la civilización tamién existió en as cuencas d'o riu, agora seco, Sarasvati, sería mas encertau denominar-la civilización Indo-Sarasvati; per la suya parte, atros la claman civilización Harappa, que ye lo nombre d'o primero d'os suyos puestos en estar excavau ena decada d'os vinte.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: La indoli marcial de l'imperio romano contribuyió a lo desenrollo d'os abances en o campo d'a medicina.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: L'emperador Augusto encomenzó a reclutar medicos que, de feito, formoron lo primer Cuerpo Medico Romano, que la suya función yera intervenir dimpués d'as batallas.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Los cirurchanos contaban con conoixencias sobre diferents sedantivos, como la morfina extraita d'as simients d'ababol u la escopolamina, obtenida de simients de belenyo.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: No nomás se convirtioron en especialistas en amputación pa salvar a qui padeixeban cangrena, sino tamién en fer torniquez y fer servir pinzas arterials pa tallar lo fluxo de sangre.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Con o paso d'os sieglos, l'imperio romano abanzó amplament en l'aria d'a medicina y desenrollo gran parte d'as conoixencias con as cuals contamos en l'actualidat.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: L'origami de tipo Pureland ye un origami en o cual nomás se permite fer un plegue cada vegada, no se pueden fer aquels que son mas complexos, como los inversos, y toz tienen ubicacions sencillas.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Lo desenrolló John Smith en a decada de 1970 pa aduyar a los plegadors inexpertos u con habilidaz motoras reducidas.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Dende bien chóvens, los ninos desenrollan bella consciencia sobre la raza y los estereotipos racials y estes zaguers afectan lo suyo comportamiento.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Per eixemplo, los ninos que s'identifican con una minoría racial que mena un estereotipo seguntes lo cual no les va bien en a escuela desenrollan una tendencia a lo fracaso escolar malas que son sabedors d'o preconcepto vinculau con a suya raza.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace ocupa lo tercer puesto entre los puestos web mas populars usaus en Estaus Unius y, en l'actualidat, tien 54 millons de perfils.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Estes puestos web han atraito muita atención, en particular en l'ambito educativo.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Existen aspectos positivos en estes puestos web, como la posibilidat de configurar de forma simpla un salón de clases virtual que puede contener blogs, videos y fotos, entre atros.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Esta pachina ye d'acceso simple, ya que tien una sola adreza web, lo que fa que los estudiants que podesen tener problemas pa usar lo teclau u pa letriar puedan recordar-la y escribir-la con facilidat.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Ye posible personalizar-la pa que sía de fácil lectura y, tamién, regular la presencia de color, seguntes se prefiera.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Lo Trastorno per Defícit d'Atención «ye un sindrome neurolochico en o cual, per definición, converchen tres sintomas: la impulsividat, la distracción y la hiperactividat u exceso d'enerchía».
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: No ye una discapacidat d'aprendizache, sino d'un trastorno d'aprendizache; «lo padeixen entre lo 3 y lo 5 per ciento d'os ninos, posiblement dica 2 millons en Estaus Unius».
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Los ninos con TDA tienen dificultat pa concentrar-se en cosas como las fayenas escolars, pero sí pueden fer-lo con actividaz que les fan goyo, como chugar, mirar los suyos dibuixos animaus preferius u escribir oracions sin puntuación.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Estes ninos tienden a ficar-se en buena cosa de problemas pus «adoptan comportamientos arrisgaus, s'involucran en barallas y desafían a l'autoridat» pa estimular lo suyo cerebro, ya que este no puede estimular-se per metodos normals.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: Lo TDA afecta los vinclos con atros companyers, dau que os atros ninos no pueden comprender per qué actúan como lo fan, per qué escriben d'a manera en que lo fan u per qué no comparten lo mesmo nivel de madurez.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: A mesura que la capacidat d'adquirir conoixencias y d'aprender ha cambiau, como ya s'ha mencionau, la taxa base d'obtención de conoixencias tamién ha cambiau.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: L'abordache pa adquirir conoixencias yera diferent. Lo foco ya no se trobaba en a memoria individual, sino que la capacidat de recordar lo texto pasó a estar lo foco.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Basicament, la Renaixencia significó un cambio contundent en a perspectiva de l'aprendizache y la transmisión de conoixencias.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Los hominidos, en contraste con atros simios, ya no fan servir las suyas mans en a locomoción ni pa aguantar lo peso ni pa bandiar-se entre los árbols.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Lo feito de que la man y lo piet d'o chimpancé sían de grandaria y largaria pareixius evidencia que usan la extremidat superior como suporte d'o suyo peso en caminar sobre los artiellos.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: La longaria d'a man d'o estar humano ye menor que la d'o piet y las suyas chunturas son mas dreitas.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Los uesos fósils d'as mans de dos a tres millons d'anyos d'antiguidat evidencian este cambio en l'uso d'a dita extremidat dende la locomoción dica la manipulación.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: I hai qui sostienen que sozmeter a muitas sesions d'inducción d'o suenio conscient de manera artificial puede estar bella cosa realment agotadera.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: La principal causa d'este fenomeno ye lo resultau d'os suenios lucidos que duran mientres lo tiempo entre los estaus REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: En producir-se menos estaus REM de nueiz, se reduz la frecuencia d'este estau en o cual s'experimenta lo descanso real y lo cuerpo recupera la suya enerchía, tornando-se pro infrecuent como pa convertir-se en un problema.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Ye igual d'agotador que si despertase cada vinte minutos u meya hora y se mirase la televisión.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Lo suyo efecto ye en función de cuán seguiu lo suyo cerebro faga l'intento de producir suenios lucidos cada nueit.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Cuasi dende l'inicio, a los italianos no les fue guaire bien en Africa d'o Norte. Pasada una semana dende que lo país declarase la guerra lo 10 de chunyo de 1940, la oncena división d'húsars britanicos ya heban preso lo la Fuerza Capuzzo, en Libia.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Lo cheneral Lastucci, enchenyero chefe d'o Deceno Exercito d'Italia, estió preso per los angleses mientres una emboscada a l'este de Bardia.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Lo fuego aliau mató, lo 28 de chunyo, a lo mariscal Italo Balbo, gubernador cheneral de Libia, y supuesto sucesor de Mussolini, mientres aterrizaba en Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: La esgrima, esporte moderno, se practica a nivels muito variaus, dende estudiants que exercitan en a universidat dica olimpiadas y competicions profesionals.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: La forma prencipal de practicar este esporte ye a traviés de duelos, en os cuals dos esgrimistas s'enfrontinan.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Lo golf ye un esporte en o cual los suyos participants miran de ficar pilotas en cloz, golpiando-las con un tocho.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Se chugan deciueito cloz en una ronda regular y, per lo cheneral, los chugadors empecipian per lo primero d'o campo y rematan en o deciuiteno.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Gana lo chugador que fa la menor cantidat de golpes u tochazos pa rematar lo recorriu.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Lo partiu se chuga sobre tasca, y la hierba que rodeya lo clot se talla mas y se diz green.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Talment, lo estilo de turismo mas habitual ye ixe que la mayor parte d'as personas relaciona con os viaches: lo recreativo.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Ixo ocurre cuan los viachers eslichen un destín muito diferent a lo d'a suya vida habitual con a finalidat de relaixar-se y divertir-se.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Las plachas, los parques tematicos y los puestos d'acampada son, a ormino, los puestos que mas frecuentan los turistas que viachan per placer.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Lo turismo cultural ye aquel que lo suyo obchectivo ye lo de visitar un puesto en particular pa conoixer la suya historia y la suya cultura.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Los turistas pueden visitar diferents puntos de referencia d'un país en particular u simplament optar per centrar-se en una sola aria.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: En veyer esta actividat, los colonizadors tamién heban solicitau refuerzos.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Las tropas de refuerzo pa las posicions debanteras incluyiban a lo 1er y lo 3er rechimiento de New Hampshire, con 200 soldaus, baixo lo mando d'os coronels John Stark y James Reed, qui dimpués ascendieron a chenerals.
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Los hombres de Stark prenioron posicions a lo largo d'o cletau en l'estrimo norte d'a ubicación d'os colonos.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Cuan la mareya baixa ubrió una crepa chunto a lo río Mystic a lo largo d'a peninsula nordeste, estendioron a escape lo cletau construyindo un paretón baixo de piedra enta lo norte, que arribaba dica las marguins d'una chicota placha.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley u Stark plantoron una estaca a bels 100 piez (30 metros) per debant d'a cleta y dioron la orden que dengún ubrise fuego dica que l'exercito regular la hese sobrepasada.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: La base d'a estratechia d'os Estaus Unius lo lanzamiento d'ataques coordinaus dende tres puntos diferents.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Lo cheneral John Cadwalder encomenzaría un ataque de distracción cuentra la guarnición britanica en Bordentown, con a intención de blocar cualsequier mena de refuerzo.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Lo cheneral James Ewing privó la fuga d'as tropas enemigas prenendo lo puent sobre Assunpink Creek y guiando a 700 soldaus a traviés d'o río en Trenton Ferry.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: L'ataque mas important, feito per 2400 hombres, trescruzaría lo río nueu millas a lo norte de Trenton pa dimpués dividir-se en dos grupos, con a finalidat de lanzar un ataque antes que no salise lo sol: un d'éls baixo lo mando de Greene y, l'atro, encabezau per Sullivan.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: En producir-se lo cambio d'a distancia d'a corrida d'un cuarto a meya milla, la velocidat pierde en gran mida la suya importancia, mientres que la resistencia se torna necesaria de tot.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Prou que un corredor de meya milla de primera categoría, que puede fer menos de dos minutos, ha de tener un buen nivel de velocidat, pero ha de cautivar la resistencia a tota costa.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.
