text: La manera d'aprestar la temporada de corridas ye la combinación d'una mica de corrida campo a traviés durant la epoca d'hibierno con un entrenamiento d'a part superior d'o cuerpo en o chimnasio.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: No ye posible que las practicas nutricionals adecuadas, per ellas mesmas, cheneren un rendimiento d'elite, pero puede influyir prou en o bienestar cheneral d'os atletas chóvens.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Tener un adecuau equilibrio enerchetico, adoptar habitos d'hidratación eficaces y prener conoixencia d'os diferents aspectos d'as practicas de suplementación puede contribuyir a que los atletas aumenten lo suyo rendimiento y disfruten mas d'o esporte.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: La corrida de distancia meya ye un esporte relativament economico; manimenos, existen muitos conceptos erronios en relación con o poco equipamiento requeriu pa participar.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Existen articlos que se pueden adquirir si se creye que son necesarios; manimenos, la mayoría d'éls no tendrá garra impacto verdadero en o rendimiento, u la suya incidencia será minima.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Los atletas pueden sentir que prefieren un producto, tot y que no les proporcione beneficios reals.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: L'atomo se puede considerar como una d'as piedras candals fundamentals de tota la materia.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Ye una estructura muito complexa que ye formada, conforme lo modelo simplificau de Bohr, per un nuclio central alredol d'o cual orbitan electrons; bella cosa semellant a las planetas que chiran arredol d'o Sol. Se veiga la Figura 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Son dos particlas las que composan lo nuclio; estas son los protons y los neutrons.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Mientres que los neutrons no tienen carga electrica, la d'os protons ye positiva y, la d'os electrons, negativa.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Pa examinar a la victima, vusté ha d'inspeccionar antes la escena pa garantizar la suya propia seguranza.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Ha d'observar-se la posición en a cual se troba la victima mientres se va acercando a él u ella, asinas como cualsequier sinyal d'alerta automatica.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Si en mirar de prestar aduya resulta feriu, ye posible que nomás empiore mas la situación.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Lo estudio determinó que la depresión, lo miedo y la catastrofización intervinioron en a dinamica entre la dolor y la discapacidat en os pacients que sufren mal en a rechión lumbar.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Nomás los efectos d'a catastrofización, no pas los d'a depresión u d'o miedo, yeran condicionaus a las sesions d'AF estructuradas, semanals y regulars.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Qui participaban en actividaz regulars demandaban mayor asistencia cuanto a la percepción negativa d'a dolor, marcando las distincions entre la dolor cronica y la sensación de malestar present en o movimiento fisico habitual.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: La vista, u la capacidat de veyer, pende d'os organos sensorials (uellos) d'o sistema visual.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: I hai numbrosas estructuras oculars diferents; la suya complexidat cambia en función d'as necesidaz de l'organismo.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Las diferents construccions tienen diferents capacidaz, son susceptibles de tener diferents largarias y graus d'agudeza; tamién requieren un procesamiento diferenciau pa dar sentiu a la dentrada y numers diferents pa que funcionen de forma optima.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Una población ye la reunión d'organismos d'una mesma especie en particular adintro una zona cheografica especifica.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Cuan los individuos miembros una población comparten bella caracteristica fenotipica particular de forma identica, le los denomina monomorficos.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Se diz polimorficos a los que amuestran diferents variants d'un mesmo treito.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Las colonias de fornigas guerreras tamién caminan y fan niedos en diferents fases.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: En a fase nomada, las fornigas guerreras abanzan de nueit y, de día, s'aturan pa acampar.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: La colonia empecipia una fase nómada cuan l minchar disponible baixa. En esta fase, fan niedos temporals que se cambian cada día.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Cadaúna d'estas caminadas u marchas dura aproximadament 17 días.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Qué ye una celula? Este termin dimana d'o latín cella, que significa «cuarto de grandaria reducida», y lo emplegó per primer vegada un microscopista mientres estudiaba la estructura d'o zuro.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: La unidat basica de tot ser vivo ye la celula y cada organismo ye formau per una u mas d'ellas.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Las celulas son basicas y crucials pa lo estudio d'a vida. En efecto, con frecuencia se les diz «las components basicas d'a vida».
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Lo sistema niervoso mantién la homeostasi a traviés d'os impulsos niervosos que ninvia a tot lo cuerpo pa que lo fluxo sanguinio corra sin interrupcions.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Estes impulsos nerviosos pueden estar ninviaus rapidament a traviés de l'organismo, lo cual contribuye a mantener-lo seguro debant de cualsequier menaza potencial.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Si bien las superficies que golpeyan los tornados son chicotas, comparadas con atras tempestas agresivas, pueden destruyir tot que troban en o suyo camín.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Los tornados desenradigan árbols, rancan panels d'os edificios y lanzan vehíclos enta lo ciel. Lo 2% mas agresivo d'os tornados dura mas de tres horas.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Estas colosals tempestas trayen vientos de dica 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Per mils y mils d'anyos las personas han fabricau y emplegau lents d'aumento.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Manimenos, los primers telescopios verdaders se fabricoron en Europa, en zaguerías d'o sieglo XVI.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Estes telescopios emplegaban una combinación de dos lents pa que los obchectos leixanos i apareixesen mas cercanos y mas grans.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: L'anglucia y l'egoísmo siempre serán con nusatros y la esencia d'a cooperación radica en que, cuan la mayoría se beneficia, siempre i habrá mas per ganar a curto termino si s'actúa de manera egoísta.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Muitas personas suenian con o día en que los humanos viacheyen ta unatra estrela y exploren atros mundos. Belunas se preguntan qué i hai astí difuera, atras creyen que en atras planetas pueden vivir extraterrestres u atras formas de vida.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Serán, talment, los suyos bisnietos bel día en a turca d'un mundo extraterrestre fendo-se preguntas sobre los suyo antepasaus?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Los animals son formaus per numbrosas celulas. Minchan alimientos y los dichieren en o suyo interior. La mayoría d'éls se pueden mover.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Se define la celula como la mas chicota unidat estructural y funcional que forma un organismo (cosas) vivo.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Lo termen celula dimana d'a parola latina cella, que quiere decir «cuarto chicot».
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Si examina un ser vivo baixo un microscopio, advertirá que son composaus per chicoz cuadraus u esferas.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Analisando un zuro con un microscopio, Robert Hooke, un biologo anglés, observó chicoz cuadraus en a suya estructura.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Pareixeban cambras. Estió la primer persona que observó celulas muertas.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Los elementos y compuestos pueden cambiar d'estau sin sufrir alteracions.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Encara que lo suyo estau fisico puede variar, lo quimico se mantiene.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Lo tiempo ye bella cosa present per toz los cabos y que tien efectos en totas las nuestras accions; manimenos, ye dificil comprender-lo.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Experimentamos lo tiempo como una serie d'esdevenimientos que pasan dende lo futuro a traviés d'o present enta lo pasau.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Lo tiempo ye tamién lo modo en o cual acomparamos la duración (extensión) d'os eventos.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Ye posible pa vusté mesmo marcar lo paso d'o tiempo observando cómo se repite un evento ciclico; ye decir, bella cosa que se produz una y atra vegada en forma regular.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Hue en día las personas usan los ordinadors pa manipular imáchens y videos.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Ye posible disenyar animacions sofisticadas per ordinador, una cosa que per cada día ye mas habitual veyer tanto en a televisión como en o cine.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Con frecuencia, la gravación de mosica se fa con ordinadors sofisticaus a fin de procesar y mesclar sonius.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Per muitos anyos, entre los sieglos XIX y XX, la creyencia estió que los habitants orichinarios de Nueva Zelanda heban estau los maoríes, que cazaban aus enormes clamadas moas.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Dimpués la teoría instauró la ideya de que lo pueblo maorí heba emigrau dende Polinesia, a bordo d'una Gran Flota, y que forachitó a los Moriori de Nueva Zelanda, instalando allí una sociedat agricola.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Nuevas prebas suchieren, manimenos, que los Moriori estioron un grupo de maoríes continentals que salioron de Nueva Zelanda y s'endrezoron enta las Islas Chatham, an que desenrolloron la suya cultura distintiva y pacifica.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Existiba, amás, unatra tribu, formada per los maorís que deixoron Nueva Zelanda, que s'asentó en as islas Chatham.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Se nombroron a éls mesmos Moriori, dimpués i habió cualques barallas y, finalment, estioron eliminaus.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Los que i participoron mientres cuantas decadas, nos aduyoron a apreciar las nuestras fortalezas y dedicación, de vez que avaluaban con sinceridat las dificultaz y dica los fracasos.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Mientres escuitábanos a atros contar las suyas historias personals, d'as suyas familias y d'as suyas formas d'organización, repleguemos información d'utilidat sobre lo pasau y respective a cualques d'as personalidaz que tenioron efectos, sían positivos u negativos, en a cultura d'a organización.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Encara que conoixer las historias personals no implica entender la cultura, esto a lo menos aduya a los individuos a poder representar lo puesto que acupan dentro d'a historia d'a organización.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Mientres lo proceso d'analisi d'os exitos y de presa de consciencia d'os fracasos, los individuos y grupos de personas involucraus descubren con mayor fondura las valors, los obchectivos y las fuerzas que impulsan la organización.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Aquí, recordar instancias anteriors de comportamiento empresarial, y los exitos obtenius gracias a éls, aduyó a aconseguir que las personas s'ubrisen a nuevos cambios y direccions pa la ilesia local.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Estas historias d'exito arrebaixoron los miedos a lo de cambio y creoron inclinacions positivas pa lo cambio en o futuro.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Los patrons de pensamiento converchent son metodos pa resolver problemas que relacionan distintas ideyas u campos, en busca d'una solución.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: L'aspecto central d'esta manera de pensar ye la rapidez, la lochica y la precisión, asinas como la identificación de cuestions facticas a traviés d'a reutilización de tecnicas existents y d'a replega de datos.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Esta clase de pensamiento tien como premisa principal la existencia de nomás una respuesta correcta. Se piensa en térmens de dos respuestas posibles, una correcta y unatra incorrecta.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Esta mena de pensamiento se relaciona con bellas ciencias u procedimientos estandardizados.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Qui piensa d'este manera, tien un pensamiento lochico, puede recordar patrones, resolver problemas y treballar en prebas cientificas.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Los seres humanos son, per muito, la especie con mas talento pa leyer la ment d'os atros
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Ixo implica que tenemos la capacidat de fer prediccions encertadas cuanto a las percepcions d'atras personas, lo que se proposan, las suyas creyencias, conoixencias y deseyos.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Entre estas capacidaz, entender la intención d'os de demás ye crucial, ya que nos permite resolver posibles ambiguidaz en as accions fisicas.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Per eixemplo, si vusté veyese a belún trencar la finestra d'un auto, probablement asumiría que ye mirando de furtar lo vehíclo d'un tercer.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Habría de chudgar de forma diferent si hese trafegau las claus d'o suyo propio auto y l'auto en o cual mira de dentrar ye lo suyo.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: La IRM se basa en un fenomeno fisico denominau resonancia magnetica nuclear (RMN), descubierto en a decada de 1930 per Felix Bloch (que treballaba pa la Universidat de Stanford) y Edward Purcell (d'a Universidat d'Harvard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: En esta resonancia, lo campo magnetico y las ondas de radio causan la emisión, per parte d'os atomos, de chicoz sinyals de radio.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Estió un medico y investigador cientifico clamau Raymond Damadian qui, en l'anyo 1970, descubrió las bases pa la utilización d'o escaneyo de resonancia magnetica como ferramienta pa lo diagnostico medico.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Dimpués de cuatro anyos se le atorgó una patent, la primera que s'emitiba a nivel mundial relacionada con a resonancia magnetica.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: En 1997, lo Dr. Damadian remató de construyir lo primer escáner de resonancia magnetica de «cuerpo entero», a lo cual nombró l'«Indomable».
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: La comunicación asincronica fomenta prener un tiempo pa reflexionar y reaccionar debant d'os atros.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Permite que los alumnos treballen a lo suyo propio ritmo y controlen lo ritmo d'a información instructiva.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Existen, amás, menos limitacions per lo que fa a lo tiempo, posibilitando horarios laborals flexibles. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: L'uso d'Internet y d'o World Wide Web permite que los estudiants tiengan acceso a la información en tot momento.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Los alumnos tamién pueden ninviar consultas a los instructors a cualsequier hora d'o día y recibir una respuesta razonablement áchil, en cuenta d'aguardar dica lo siguient alcuentro en persona.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: L'enfoque posmodernista de l'aprendizache conlleva la liberación d'os absolutos; no existe nomás una forma correcta d'aprender.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Pa ilustrar este punto, ye prou con remitir-nos a la nuestra experiencia actual con toz los programas televisivos que s'enfocan en l'aprendizache “fe-te-lo tu mesmo” y en a información que presentan.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Somos muitos los que nos hemos trobau mirando programas de televisión que proporcionan información sobre procesos u experiencias en os cuals nunca tendremos participación ni aplicaremos ixes conoiximientos.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Nunca no repararemos un vehíclo, ni construyiremos una fuent en o patio trasero d'a nuestra casa, ni iremos ta Perú pa examinar ruinas antigas, ni remodelaremos la casa d'o vecino.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Las connexions de cable de fibra optica submarinos que plegan en Europa y lo satélite de banda ampla fan posible que Groenlandia tienga una buena conectividat y que lo 93% d'a población tienga acceso a Internet.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Como ya s'ha sinyalau, si bien la parola «esquimal» se sigue aceptando en os Estaus Unius, muitas comunidaz articas no estausunidenses la consideran ofensiva, en particular en Canadá.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Lo clima fredo ye, talment, lo solo verdadero periglo con o cual pueden tener que lidiar qui no s'haigan aprestau.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Si visita Groenlandia en as estacions fredas (considerando que cuanto mas vaiga enta lo norte, menor será la temperatura), ye crucial levar ropa prou d'abrigo.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Los largos días d'o verano pueden dificultar adormir prous horas y pueden causar atros problemas de salut relacionaus.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Lo feito que sía evocada con frecuencia en cancions, cintas, obras de literatura y en a cultura popular ha colaborau pa que la ciudat y los suyos monimentos sían famosos a nivel mundial.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Lo viache ta Walt Disney World ye, pa muitas familias d'os Estaus Unius, una gran pelegrinación.

text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Cal contar con un permiso de zona especial pa poder acampar per debaixo d'o canto d'o Gran Canyón.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: A fin de protecher lo canyón, s'entrega un cupo limitau de permisos, los cuals nomás se pueden solicitar lo primer día de cada mes, en os cuatro meses previos a l'inicio.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Per ixo, los permisos de zona especial pa cualsequier data d'inicio en o mes de mayo serán disponibles dende l'1 de chinero.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Per un regular, lo espacio pa las zonas mas visitadas, como lo Bright Angel Campground, que ye chunto a Phantom Ranch, se plena de solicituz que plegan en a primer data disponible pa fer reservas.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: I hai un cupo limitau de permisos, reservaus pa las solicituz sin reserva previa, que s'entregan per orden d'arribada.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Una fantastica forma de contemplar tot l'encanto d'a rechión d'o sud d'Africa ye dentrar-ie en auto, lo cual tamién le permitirá acceder a puestos difuera d'as rotas turisticas habituals.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Esto puede fer-se en un auto normal con una planificación cudiadoas, pero lo mas recomendable ye fer-lo en un 4x4; amás, i hai muitos puestos a los cuals nomás se puede acceder con un 4x4 de ruedas elevadas.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Cuan planifique lo suyo viache, considere que, tot y que Africa d'o Sud ye estable, no toz los países que la rodeyan en son.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Per lo que fa a los requerimientos y costes pa obtener lo suyo visau, ixo penderá d'o país d'an que provienga y, amás, cambia de país en país.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Amás, cada país tien leis propias que determinan qué articlos d'emerchencia han de trobar-se endentro de l'auto.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls ye una ciudat en l'ueste de Zimbabwe, pasando la buega con Livingstone, Zambia, y cerca de Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: La ciudat se plaza chunto a las cataratas, que son lo suyo prencipal atractivo, pero este conoixiu destín turistico tamién ofreix, tanto a aventurers como a viachers, un gran numero d'opcions pa una estancia de mayor duración.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: En epoca de precipitacions (de noviembre a marzo), lo volumen d'augua creixerá y las cataratas serán mas impresionants.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: No dude que rematará mullau si trescruza lo puent u recorre los viers sinuosos cercanos a las cataratas.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Per atro costau, precisament perque lo volumen d'augua ye tan elevau, la visión d'as cataratas reals se veyerá tapada per tota l'augua!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: La fuesa de Tutankamón (KV62). La fuesa KV62 puede considerar la mas famosa en a Val d'os Reis, escenario d'o descubrimiento per Howard Carter, en 1922, d'o cuasi intacto sepulcre reyal d'o choven faraón.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Manimenos, acomparada con a mayor parte d'as de demás fuesas reyals, la de Tutankamón nosi no mereixe estar visitada, dau que ye muito mas chicota y ye tasament decorada.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Cualsequier interesau en observar los danyos causaus a la momia en os intentos de quitar-la de l'ataúl se decepcionaría, ya que nomás son visibles la cabeza y los huembros.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Actualment, las choyas d'a fuesa no se troban allí, sino que han estau tresladadas a lo Museu Echipcio, en o Caire.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Pa los visitantes con poco tiempo sería convenient que lo invertisen en unatro puesto.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom. Ye un templo edificau en a tuca d'una colina ta zaguers d'o sieglo IX, mientres lo reinau de Yasovarman, a 12 km a lo sud de Siem Reap.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: L'atmosfera tetrica d'o templo y la vista d'o lago Tonle Sap fan que l'ascenso per la colina tienga la suya recompensa.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Puede organizar una profitosa combinación entre una visita a lo puesto y un paseyo en barca ta lo lago.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Fa falta lo pase d'Angkor pa acceder a lo templo, asinas que no olbide lo suyo pasaporte cuan vaiga ta Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Tot y que Cherusalem ye la ciudat capital y la mas gran d'Israel, la mayoría d'os atros estaus y las Nacions Unidas no la reconoixen como tal.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: La lechendaria ciudat en os Monts de Chudea tien una increyible historia milenaria.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Los tres cultos monoteístas; ye decir, lo chudaísmo, lo cristianismo y l'islam, la consideran una ciudat sagrada, y funciona como siede espiritual, relichiosa y cultural.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Per lo significau relichioso d'a ciudat y, en particular, de buena cosa de puestos d'o casco antigo que siguen en piet a día de hue, Cherusalem ye un d'os destins turisticos mas populars d'Israel.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: I hai muitos puestos historicos, arqueolochicos y culturals en Cherusalem, amás de vibrants y concorrius centros comercials, tabiernas y restaurants.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: En o caso d'os ciudadanos provenientes de Cuba, Ecuador exichen que haigan recibiu una carta d'invitación antes de dentrar en o país per aeropuertos internacionals u puestos d'admisión en as buegas.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: S'exiche que esta carta sía legalizada per lo Ministerio de Relacions Exteriors d'Ecuador y que cumpla bels requisitos.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: L'obchectivo d'estes requisitos ye proporcionar una circulación migratoria organizada entre los dos países.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Qui proviengan de Cuba y conten con una tarcheta verde d'os Estaus Unius, la han de presentar debant d'un consulau ecuatoriano pa que se les atorgue la exención d'este requerimiento.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: S'exiche que la vichencia d'o suyo pasaporte s'extienda per a lo menos 6 meses mas dimpués d'as suyas datas de viache. Se quiere, amás, que conte con un pasache d'ida y de tornada, ixo a la fin de comprebar la extensión d'a suya estancia.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Las excursions son mas economicas pa grupos de mas personas, asinas que, si ye solo u nomás con un amigo, procure conoixer chent y formar un grupo de cuatro a seis pa obtener un millor precio per persona.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Manimenos, no s'habría de preocupar per esto ya que, a sobén, los turistas se combinan pa emplir los autos.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: En realidat, mas bien pareix una forma d'enganyar a la chent pa fer-les creyer que ha de pagar mas.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Cosirando dende lo cabo norte de Machu Picchu, se troba esta montanya de gran pendient, a sobén ye lo paisache de fondo de muitas fotografías d'as ruinas.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Dende abaixo resulta una mica imponent y ye una puyada empinada y difícil, pero la mayoría d'a chent con una forma fisica minima la habría de poder fer en bels 45 minutos.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Los escalerons de piedra se troban a lo largo de cuasi tot lo camín, y en as partes de pendient mas gran, i hai cables d'acero pa agafar-se-ie.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Manimenos, se prepare pa quedar-se sin aliento y pare cuenta con as partes mas empinadas, mas que mas si son humedas, ya que se pueden tornar periglosas decamín.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Cerca d'a tuca se troba una espelunga chicota per la cual cal pasar. Ye prou baixa y estreita.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: A bordo d'una barca ye como millor se contemplan los puestos y la vida silvestre d'as Galapagos, d'a mesma manera que lo fació Charles Darwin en 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Mas de 60 crucers navegan sobre las auguas d'as Galapagos, con capacidaz d'entre 8 y 100 pasachers.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: La mayoría d'as personas reservan la suya plaza con muita anticipación, ya que los barcos se gosan emplir en temporada alta.
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Asegure-se de que l'achent que le fa la reserva ye un especialista d'as Galapagos con buen conoiximiento d'una ampla  variedat de barcos.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Ixo le asegurará que las suyas preferencias u limitacions personals coincidan con o barco mas adecuau a ellas.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Dica lo sieglo XVI, en a era prehispanica, lo norte de Chile yera de dominio inca, mientres que los indichenas araucanos (mapuches) viviban en o centro y sud d'o país.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Los mapuches tamién estioron uno d'os zaguers grupos americanos que no quedoron de tot absorbius per la regulación hispanoparlant dica dimpués d'a independencia de Chile.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Encara que la independencia de Chile estió declarada en 1810 (epoca en a cual, a resultas d'as guerras napoleónicas, Espanya heba quedau sin un gubierno central operativo durant dos anyos), lo triunfo decisivo cuentra los espanyols no ocurrió dica 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: La Republica Dominicana ye un país d'o Caribe que ocupa la metat oriental d'a isla La Espanyola, la cual comparte con Haití.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Amás d'as suyas plachas d'arena blanca y d'os suyos paisaches de montanya, lo país aculle la ciudat europea mas antiga d'America, que agora fa parte de Santo Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Los primers pobladors d'a isla estioron los taínos y los caribes; estes zaguers, que charraban la luenga arahuaca, heban plegau en a isla aproximadament en l'anyo 10.000 a. de C.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Pocos anyos dimpués de l'arribada d'os exploradors europeus, los conqueridors espanyols reducioron significativament la población de taínos.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Seguntes Flai Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratau d'as Indias), los colonos provenientes d'Espanya asasinoron a bels cient mil taínos entre 1492 y 1498.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Chardín d'a Unión. Este puesto se construyió como atrio pa un convento d'o sieglo XVII, d'o cual nomás se conserva l'edificio d'o Templo de Sant Diego.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Agora funciona como la plaza central, an que siempre pasan muitas cosas, tanto de día como de nueit.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Lo chardín ye rodiau per cuantos restaurants y, de tardes y de nueiz, se gosan ufrir conciertos gratuitos dende la glorieta central.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Lo Callizo d'o Beso: Dos balcons que deseparaus per nomás 69 cm, que son lo puesto an que s'orichina una antiga leyenda romantica.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Cualques ninos contarán un cuento a cambio de bella moneda.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: La isla de Bowen ye un conoixiu viache d'un día u excursión de cabo de semana que ofreix actividaz como kayak, senderismo, botigas pa fer crompas, restaurants y mas cosas.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: En Howe Sound, chusto a lo canto de Vancouver, se troba esta autentica comunidat a la cual se puede arribar facilment en taxis acuaticos programaus que salen dende Granville Island, en o centro de Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Pa qui disfrutan d'as actividaz a l'aire libre, no puede faltar una excursión per lo corredor Sea to Sky.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler, que se troba a una hora y meya en auto dende Vancouver, ye cara pero conoixida per los Chuegos Olimpicos d'Hibierno de 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: D'hibierno, disfrute de beluns d'os millors puestos d'esquí de Norteamerica y, de verano, experimente l'autentico ciclismo de montanya.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: S'han de reservar los permisos con antelación. Pa pasar la nueit en Sirena, s'exiche tener un permiso.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: La sola estación de guardas forestals que ofreix alochamiento en cambras y alimentos calients amás d'o campamento ye Sirena. No ye asinas en La Leona, San Pedrillo y Los Patos, an que nomás s'ofreix l'acampada, sin servicio de minchar.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Si bien se pueden reservar permisos pa estacionar dreitament dende la estación de guardas forestals de Puerto Jiménez, no se puede pagar con tarchetas de credito.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Lo Servicio de Parques (MINAE) no atorga permisos de dentrada con mas d'un mes d'anticipación a la data d'arribada prevista.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol ofreix un servicio de reservas per un coste de 30 dólars d'os EUA u 10 dólars per los pases d'un día; mas detalles, en a pachina d'o Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Las islas Cook, en Polinesia, en l'Oceano Pacifico, son un estau insular librement asociau a Nueva Zelanda.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Ye un archipelago formau per 15 islas que se distribuyen en una superficie oceanica de 2.2 millons de km².
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Como comparte la mesma zona horaria que Hawaii, a vegadas estas islas son denominadas lo «Hawaii d'o sud».
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Tot y que ye mas chicot, a cualques visitants grans les fa acordanza de Hawaii, antes que no se convertise en un estau y no existisen toz los grans hotels turisticos y atros desenrollos.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Encara que no tienen garra ciudat, las islas Cook son formadas per 15 islas. Las mas importants son Rarotonga y Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: En l'actualidat, la ufierta d'alochamiento y desayuno de luxo s'ha tornau, pa los países d'o primer mundo, una mena de forma d'arte.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: En a millor categoría, la competición entre los B&B se da, mas que mas, en dos servicios: la ropa de leito y lo desayuno.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Per tanto, en os establimientos mas exclusivos d'esta mena, se puede trobar la ropa de leito mas luxosa, talment una vanova teixida a man u un leito antigo.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Pa lo desayuno pueden servir delicias de temporada d'ixa rechión u la especialidat de l'anfitrión.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Lo escenario podría estar un edificio historico con muebles antigos, chardins impecables u una piscina de natación.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Puyar ta l'auto y encomenzar un extenso viache per tierra ha d'estar un atractivo intrinseco per la suya simplicidat.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: A diferencia d'o que ocurre con os autos mas grans, ye probable que vusté ya se trobe familiarizau con a conducción d'o suyo auto y en conoixca las limitaciones.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Devantar una carpa en un terreno privau u en un lugar de cualsequier dimension puede fácilment trucar l'atención de manera no deseyada.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: En resumen, l'auto ye una muit buena opción pa fer un viache per carretera, pero per no le gosará servir como una manera d'«acampar».
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: L'acampada en auto ye posible si tiens una furgoneta ampla, un SUV, una berlina u una cambioneta con asientos reclinables.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Cualques hotels son duenyos d'un legau d'a edat d'oro d'o tren a vapor y d'os transatlanticos, que datan d'antes d'a Segunda Guerra Mundial, en o sieglo XIX u encomienzos d'o sieglo XX.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: En estes hotels s'alochaban os ricos y famosos d'alavez y, a sobén, disfrutaban de buenas cenas y vida nocturna.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Los accesorios anticuaus, la falta d'as comodidaz mas actualizadas y bella antiguidat sofisticada son tamién parte d'o suyo carácter.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Anque, per un regular, gosan estar de propiedat privada, en ocasions alochan a chefes d'estau y atros mandatoarios visitants.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Un viachero con muitos dienrs podría considerar fer la vuelta a lo mundo en avión, con pausas pa alochar-se en muitos d'estes hotels.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Un ret d'intercambio d'alochamiento consiste en una organización que connecta a los viachers con os residents d'os destins que visitarán.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Pa unir-se a un ret asinas, per un regular, nomás cal emplenar un cuestionario, tot y que bels rez ufreixen u demandan un verificacion adicional.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Dimpués s'ofreix un listau d'os anfitrions disponibles, impreso u en linia, que a vegadas tienen referencias y comentarios d'atros viachers.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing prencipió en chinero de 2004, dimpués que un programador informatico clamau Casey Fenton aconseguise un vuelo de baixo coste a Islandia, pero no trobase un puesto an que alochar-se-ie.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Escribió per correu electronico a alumnos d'a universidat d'a zona y recibió un buena cosa d'ofreiximientos d'alochamiento gratuito.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Per un regular, los albergues alochan a chent choven (un huespede promedio tendrá bels vintitantos anyos), pero a ormino se pueden trobar viachers mas grans.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Las familias con fillos son de mal veyer, pero bels albergues los aceptan en cuartos privaus.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: La ciudat de Pekín, en China, será anfitriona d'os Chuegos Olimpicos d'Hibierno en 2022, lo cual la convertirá en a primer ciudat siede d'os chuegos de verano y d'hibierno.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Pekín será anfitriona d'as ceremonias d'obridura y clausura y d'os eventos sobre chelo que se realicen baixo teito.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: En l'aria d'esquí ubicada en Taizicheng, Zhangjiakou, que se troba a bels 220 km (140 mi) de Pekín, se farán atros eventos d'ixe esporte.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: La mayoría d'os templos celebran un festival anyal que encomienza entre finals de noviembre y meyaus de mayo, lo cual pende d'o calandario anyal de cada templo.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: La mayoría d'os festivals en o templo se celebran como parte de l'aniversario d'o mesmo u lo cumpleaños d'a deidat reinant, u cualsequier atro evento important que se relacione con o templo.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Una procesión regular d'elefants decoraus, la orquesta d'o templo y atras festividaz fan que los festivals d'o templo de Kerela sían muito seductors.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Una Feria Mundial (per un regular clamada Exposición Mundial, u simplament Expo) ye un gran festival internacional an que converchen artes y ciencias.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Los países que i participan presentan las suyas muestras artisticas y educativas en pabellons nacionals, sía pa ilustrar problemas mundials u pa amostrar la historia y cultura d'o país.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Los eventos internacionals d'horticultura son trobadas especializadas en os cuals s'exposan arreglos florals, chardins botanicos y tot ixo vinculau con las plantas.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Si bien en teoría se fan una vegada a l'anyo (siempre que sía en países diferents), en a practica  no ye asinas.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Estes eventos gosan durar de tres a seis meses y se fan en puestos d'una superficie no menor a 50 hectarias.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: A traviés d'os anyos, s'ha emplegau numbrosos formatos de cintas. La estándard, de 35 mm (negativo de 36 per 24 mm), ye la mas habitual.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Per un regular, se puede reponer facilment si s'acora y ofreix una resolución semellant a la d'a DSLR actual.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: I hai camaras de cintas con formato meyo que en fan servir uno de 6 per 6 cm, mas concretament, un negativo de 56 per 56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Ixo permite cuasi lo cuadruple de resolución que con un negativo de 35 mm (3136 mm² en cuentas de 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Un d'os temas mas desafiadors pa los fotografos ye la vida salvache, y requiere una combinación de buena suerte, paciencia, experiencia y un buen equipamiento.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: A vegadas no se valora la fotografía d'a vida salvache. Manimenos, como pasa en esta disciplina en cheneral, una imachen vale mas que mil parolas.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Per un regular, pa la fotografía de vida salvache cal fer servir un teleobchectivo largo, encara que se requiere unatra mena de lents pa cosas como una banda de muixons u bella criatura chicorrona.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Muitas especies exoticas son de mal trobar y ye habitual que los parques imposen restriccions a fer fotografías con obchectivos comercials.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: I hai criaturas salvaches timidas y atras agresivas. L'entorno puede estar de baixas temperaturas, calido u hostil.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: En tota la planeta, i hai mas de 5000 idiomas diferents, entre los cuals mas de vinte son charraus per 50 millons de personas, u mas.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Lo que se comunica per escrito gosa estar mas fácil de comprender que lo que se diz de forma oral. Un eixemplo esclatero en ye lo caso d'as adrezas, que a sobén son dificils de pronunciar de una manera que s'entienda.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Muitos países enters charran con total fluidez l'anglés y en encara muitos mas puede esperar trobar bella conoixencia de l'idioma, en particular entre los mas chóvens.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: S'imachine, per dar un eixemplo, a un mancuniano, un bostoniano, un chamaicano y un ciudadano de Sydney posaus en a mesa compartindo una cena en un restaurant de Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Se deleitan mutuament con historias d'as suyas ciudaz natals, narradas con os suyos distintos accentos y a suya fabla local.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Per un regular, la forma mas barata d'alimentar-e ye mercando lo minchar en os supermercaus. Manimenos, si cocinar no ye posible, las opcions se reducen a los alimentos ya precocinaus.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Los supermercaus reciben cada vegada una mayor variedat d'alimentos precocinaus. Beluns, mesmo ofreixen un microondas u atros medios pa fer calentari-ie los platos.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: En cualques países u tipos de botigas, i hai a lo menos un restaurant endentro d'o puesto, que, per lo cheneral, ye mas bien informal y los suyos pres, economicos.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Faiga copias d'a suya poliza y las leve con vusté, de conchunta con a información de contacto d'a suya companyía de seguranzas.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Pa obtener asesoramiento u autorizacions y fer reclamos, han d'amostrar lo correu electronico de l'aseguradora y los suyos numeros de telefono internacionals.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Alze unatra copia en a valisa y una dichital (ninvia-la per correu electronico como fichero adchunto u puya-la a la «boira»).
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Si viachas con un ordinador portatil u una tableta, alza una copia en a memoria u en o disco a la cual pueda acceder sin servicio d'Internet.
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Da-les tamién copias d'a poliza y d'os datos de contacto a los companyers de viache y a familiars y amigos en o tuyo país que sían prestos a aduyar-ie.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Los alces (tamién clamaus ants) no tienen una naturaleza agresiva pero, con tot y con ixo, se desfenderán si se sienten menazaus.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Si los individuos no perciben que los alces sían potencialment agresivos, se podrían acercar mas d'o que cal y meter-se en periglo.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Beba alcol con moderación. L'alcol afecta a cada persona de manera diferent y conoixer los suyos propios limites ye muito important.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Beber alcol en exceso puede causar problemas de salut cronicos como danyo hepatico y mesmo ceguera y muerte. Lo periglo potencial creix con o consumo d'alcol produciu ilegalment.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: En as bebidas alcolicas ilegals puede haber-ie cuantas impurezas periglosas, como lo metanol, que pueden prevocar ceguera u mesmo la muerte, mesmo en chicotas cantidaz.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: As lunetas pueden estar mas economicas en un país forano, en particular en aquels de baixos ingresos an que los costes laborals son menors.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Considere la opción de fer-se un examen ocular en o suyo país d'orichen si lo cubre lo seguro, y dimpués levar la prescripción medica pa presentar-la en cualsequier atro destín d'o mundo.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Las monturas de marcas d'alta calidat que se pueden trobar en ixa zona pueden presentar dos inconvenients: belunas pueden estar imitacions y las importadas autenticas pueden estar mas caras que no en o país d'orichen.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Lo café ye uno d'os productos basicos que mas se comercializa a nivel mundial y ye probable que trobe muitas variedaz en a suya rechión d'orichen.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Manimenos, i hai muitas formas diferents de prener café en tota la planeta, que mereixen estar prebadas.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Lo barranquismo consiste en ir dica lo fondo d'un barranco, que puede estar seco u pleno d'augua.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Encara que lo barranquismo combina elementos tanto d'a natación, como d'a escalada y lo salto, ye un esporte que exiche relativament poco entrenamiento u estau fisico pa qui s'inician en él (en comparanza, per eixemplo, con a escalada en montanya, lo submarinismo u lo esquí alpino).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Lo senderismo ye una actividat que se practica a l'aire libre y que consiste en fer gambadas per entornos naturals, a ormino per rotas de senderismo.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Lo senderismo de día implica dende distancias de menos d'una milla dica distancias mas largas, que se pueden cubrir en un solo día.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Pa una gambada de día per un sendero sencillo fa falta poca preparacion y cualsequier persona moderadament en forma puede fer-la.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Si bien ye posible que los grupos familiars con ninos chicoz necesiten mas preparación, mesmo con bebés y zagals en edat preescolar, ye sencillo pasar un día a l'aire libre.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: A nivel mundial, i hai alredol de 200 organizacions de turismo pa corredors. La mayoría operan de manera independient.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Go! Running Tours, sucesora de Global Running Tours, connecta a docenas de proveyedors de turismo de corridas en cuatro continents.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Con oríchens en o Running Tours Barcelona, d'ixa ciudat, y lo Running Copenhagen, d'esta atra, decamín se i unioron lo Running Tours Prague con base en Praga y atros mas.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Son muitas las cuestions a considerar dinantes y en o momento de viachar ta bel destín.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Cuan viacheyes, no esperes que tot sía «como en casa». I habrá bellas diferencias en cosas como los modals, la lechislación, lo minchar, lo transito, l'alochamiento, las normas, l'idioma, entre atros.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Ixo s'ha de tener siempre present a la hora de evitar-se decepcions y, mesmo, bel enueyo a resultas d'as formas locals de fer las cosas.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Las achencias de viaches han existiu dende lo sieglo XIX. Per un regular, un achent de viaches ye una buena opción pa casos en que lo viachero no cuenta con experiencia previa en cuestions como la naturaleza, la cultura, l'idioma u los países de baixos ingresos.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Si bien gran parte d'as achencias son disposadas a asumir tota mena de reservas, muitos achents s'especializan en bel tipo de viaches, rangos de presupuestos u destins especificos.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Puede estar convenient contactar a un achent que faiga reservas frecuents de viaches semellants a los suyos.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Consulte los viaches promocionaus per l'achent. Puede fer-lo en una pachina web u bien en o escaparate d'o negocio.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Si quiere conoixer lo mundo a un baixo coste, sía per necesidat, estilo de vida u como un reto, existen cualques maneras de fer-lo.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Se dividen, en esencia, en dos clases: los que treballan mientres viacheyan y los que miran de reducir las expensas. Este articlo tracta sobre los segundos.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Qui accepte sacrificar la comodidat, lo tiempo y la predictibilidat pa abaixar los costes practicament a zero, pueden mirar en viaches de presupuesto minimo.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Lo consello asume que los viachers no roban, ni trespasan la propiedat privada, ni participan en o mercau ilegal, ni mendigan ni espleitan a atras personas en beneficio propio.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Per un regular, un puesto de control d'immigración ye la primera aturada malas que se baixa d'una aeronau, barco u belatro medio de transporte.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: En bels ferrocarrils transfronterizos, se fan inspeccions endentro d'o tren en movimiento, per lo cual ha de tener una identificación valida en abordar un d'éls.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: En os ferrocarrils nocturnos, lo conductor puede replegar los pasaportes pa no interrumpir lo suyo suenio.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Lo rechistro ye una exichencia adicional pa lo proceso d'o visau. En cualques países, habrá de rechistrar la suya presencia y l'adreza d'o suyo alochamiento con as autoridaz locals.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Esto podría requerir que s'impla un formulario debant d'a policía local u que se presiente en a oficina d'immigración.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: En muitos países an que richen leis d'este tipo, los hotels locals s'acupan de fer lo rechistro (no s'olbide de consultar).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: En atros casos, nomás qui s'hospeden difuera d'alochamientos turisticos amenesten s'han de rechistrar. Manimenos, esto fa que la lei sía muito mas incierta, asinas que mire d'enterar-se con antelacion.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: L'arquitectura s'acupa d'o disenyo y d'a construcción d'edificios. L'arquitectura d'un puesto gosa estar una atracción toristica per ella mesma.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Muitos edificios son realment fermosos a la vista y lo paisache dende aquels de gran altaria u con finestras estratechicament ubicadas puede estar una belleza digna d'alufrar.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: L'arquitectura tien numbrosos puntos de trobada con atras disciplinas, entre las cuals s'incluyen la planificación urbana, la enchenyería civil, l'arte decorativo, lo disenyo d'interiors y lo paisachismo.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Dada la leixanía de muitos d'os lugars, no trobará masiada vida nocturna si no viacheya dica Albuquerque u Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Con tot y con ixo, la mayoría d'os casinos dinantes referius sirven bebidas y cuantos d'éls ofreixen espectáculos de renombre (prencipalment los mas grans, situaus arredol d'Albuquerque y Santa Fe).
