text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Para cuenta: las tabiernas d'os lugars chicoz d'aquí no siempre son una buena opción pa los visitants d'atros países.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Pa encomenzar, lo norte de Nuevo Mexico tien serios problemas de conductors ebrios y la suya concentración ye especialment alta alredol d'as chicotas tabiernas d'a ciudat.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Los murals u garabatos indeseyaus reciben lo nombre de grafiti.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Tot y que ye luent d'estar un fenomeno moderno, la mayoría d'as personas lo gosa relacionar con o vandalismo en propiedaz publicas y privadas per parte de chóvens fendo servir pintura en aerosol.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Manimenos, en l'actualidat i hai  artistas d'o grafiti reconoixius, se celebran eventos d'esta disciplina y i hai muros «legals». En este contexto, las pinturas de grafiti pueden, a ormino, asemellarse mas a obras d'arte que a etiquetas ilechibles.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Muitos turistas deseyan dominar l'habilidat de lanzar un búmerang.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Si deseyas aprender cómo lanzar un búmeran y que torne ta la tuya man, asegura-te de tener-ne uno d'os que tornan.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: En verdat, la mayoría d'os búmerang disponibles en Australia no tornan ta lo puesto dende an se lanzan. Cuanto a los novenzanos ye convenient no intentar arrullar-los si fa aire.
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Un plato tipico Hangi se prepara endentro d'un clot calient feito en o suelo.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Lo pozo se calienta con piedras calients quitadas d'o fuego u, en cualques puestos, la calor cheotermica fa que bellas zonas de tierra se calienten de forma natural.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: L'hangi se fa servir muito pa cocinar una cena rustida a lo estilo tradicional.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Uns cuantos puestos en Rotorua ofreixen hangi cheotermicos, mientres que atros hangi se pueden prebar en Christchurch, Wellington, y cualsequier atro puesto.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail cuenta con dos tipos de ferrocarrils suburbanos en Ciudat d'o Cabo y la redolada: MetroPlus (tamién conoixiu como Primera Clase) y Metro (denominau Tercera Clase).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus ofreix mas comodidat y menos concurrencia de personas, encara que ye una mica mas caro. Manimenos, sigue estando mas economico que no los billez normals de metro en Europa.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Cada tren tien vagons MetroPlus y Metro; los primers siempre se troban en o cabo d'o tren mas cercano a Ciudat d'o Cabo.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Portar cosas d'atri: Nunca no pierda de vista lo suyo equipache, en especial cuan cruce buegas internacionals.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Se podría trobar con que lo son emplegando como transportador de droga sin saber-lo, lo cual le podría trayer muitismos problemas.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Esto incluye haber d'aguardar fendo una ringlera mientres se pueden fer servir cans que uloran la droga en cualsequier momento, sin previo aviso.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Cualques países imposan castigos excesivament severos, con penas de dica 10 anyos u la muerte, mesmo pa primers delitos.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: L'equipache que se desatiende se torna un obchectivo de furtos y, de vez, atraye l'atención d'as autoridaz, que se troban a l'aguait debant de posibles menazas de bomba.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: En o suyo país d'orichen, per esta permanent exposición a los chermens locals, ye cuasi seguro que ya sía immune a éls.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Manimenos, en atras partes d'o mundo, an que la fauna  bacteriolochica ye nueva pa vusté, i hai grans posibilidaz de que tienga problemas.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Amás, en climas con temperaturas mas elevadas, las bacterias se desenrollan con más velocidat y aconsiguen vivir mas tiempo difuera d'o cuerpo.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: D'astí la diarreas d'o viachero como las d'o estomaco de Delhi, la maldición d'o faraón y la venganza de Moctezuma, y muitas atras variants.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Como pasa con os problemas respiratorios en climas mas fredos, las condicions intestinals en climas calidos son pro habituals y, encara clarament molestas, en a mayor parte d'os casos no son realment periglosas.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Si ye lo suyo primer viache ta un país en vías de desenrollo u ta bel puesto ta an que nunca no ha iu, no subestime lo posible impacto cultural.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Mas d'un viachero estable y capable s'ha visto superau per las novedaz en viachar a países en vías de desenrollo, an que i hai muitos chicoz achustes culturals que s'acumulan a escape.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: En especial durant los primers días, considere la posibilidat de gastar buens diners en hotels, minchar y servicios de buena calidat y d'estilo occidental.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Ye recomendable no adormir sobre un colchón u una colchoneta en tierra en zonas an que no conoixca la fauna local.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Si va a acampar, leve un leito u una hamaca pa mantener-se leixos d'as sierpes, los arraclans y atra fauna pareixida.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Impla la suya casa con un rico café de maitins y con una mica de camamila relaxant de nueit.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Cuan vusté ye de vacanzas en casa suya, tien lo tiempo necesario dar-se un gusto y adedicar bels minutos a cocinar bel plato especial.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Si s'anima a experimentar mas aventuras, aprofite la oportunidat de beber un suco u de mesclar cualques batius:
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Talment trobe una bebida simpla que se puede fer pa lo desayuno cuan torne ta la suya rutina diaria.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Si vusté vive en una ciudat con una cultura de bebida variada, visite tabiernas u pubs en barrios a los cuals no gose ir.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Pa qui desconoixca la terminolochía medica, «infeccioso» y «contachioso» no significan la mesma cosa.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Se denomina malotía infecciosa a la que ye prevocada per un patocheno, per eixemplo un virus, una bacteria, un fongo u belatro organismo parasitario.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Se denomina malotía contachiosa a la que se transmite con facilidat en trobar-se cerca de bel infectau.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Las autoridaz de numbrosos países exichen la vacunación cuentra distintas malotías a los viachers que i dentran u a los residents que i salen.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: A sobén, estes requisitos penden d'os países que s'haigan visitau u se tienga la intención de visitar.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Una d'as principals avantallas de Charlotte, en Carolina d'o Norte, ye que ofreix un buen numero d'opcions de calidat pa familias.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Los residents d'atras rechions gosan mencionar que la buena vida familiar ye la razón primaria pa mdar-se allí y, muitas vegadas, los visitants descubren que ye fácil disfrutar d'a ciudat con os ninos alredol.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: La variedat d'opcions pensadas pa ninos d'Uptown Charlotte ha creixiu en forma vertichinosa entre los zaguers 20 anyos.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: En Charlotte, no ye común que las familias prengan taxis, pero pueden estar de bella utilidat en bellas situacions.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: S'aplica un sobrecargo si son mas de dos pasachers, per lo cual esta opción podría estar mas cara d'o normal.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: L'Antartida ye lo puesto de menor temperatura d'a planeta y rodeya lo Polo Sud.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Las visitas turisticas tienen pres elevaus, amás de que requieren buenas condicions fisicas, nomás se pueden fer en verano de noviembre a febrero y se circumscriben mas que mas a la peninsula, las islas y lo mar de Ross.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Un par de milars d'emplegaus viven aquí en o verano, en bellas cuatro docenas de bases, mayoritariament plazadas en ixas rechions, pero nomás un chicot numero se queda d'hibierno.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: En o suyo interior, l'Antartida consiste en una meseta desierta revestida per 2 a 3 kilometros de chelo.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: De cabo ta cuan, se fan excursions aerias especializadas que i dentran pa practicar montanyismo u endrezar-se dica lo Polo, an que i hai una base gran.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: La carretera (u autopista) de McMurdo a lo Polo Sud ye un camín de 1600 km dende la base McMurdo, en o mar de Ross, dica lo Polo.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Se trata de nieu preta, con crepas plenadas y senyalizadas con banderas. Nomás pueden circular per allí tractors especials, cargando esturrazos con combustible u atros suministros.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Estes no son masiau áchils, a causa d'o cual lo camín ha de dar un largo chiro rodiando las montanyas Transantarticas pa aconseguir la meseta.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: En epoca hibernal, la causa mas habitual d'accidents son las carreteras, los pavimentos (faceras) y, en particular, los escalerons esvarizosos.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Ye esencial que tienga, como poco, calzau con suelas apropiadas. Los zapatos de verano per lo cheneral esvaran muito en o chelo y la nieu, mesmo i hai botas d'hibierno que no son adecuadas.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Cal que lo patrón tienga una profundidat apropiada, de 5 mm (1/5 pulgadas) u superior, y que lo material sía pro suau en temperaturas baixas.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: I hai botas con tachas y tamién accesorios con tachas, pa condicions esvarizosas, que s'adapta a cuasi cualsequier calzau, tanto pa los tacons como pa la suela.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Cal que los tacons sían baixos y amplos.  A a ormino, s'esparde arena, grava u sal (cloruro de calcio) sobre las carreteras u camins a fin d'obtener una millor adherencia.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Las avalanchas no son un feito extraordinario; las pendients, pronunciadas solament, resiste una poca de nieu, per lo cual l'exceso cayerá en forma de lurtes.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Lo problema ye en que la nieu ye apegallosa, motivo per lo cual requiere bella activación pa cayer, y una mica de nieu que i baix puede servir de desencadenant pa la resta.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: A vegadas, lo factor desencadenant ye lo sol que fa calentar la nieu. En atros casos, ye una nevada mas gran, atras vegadas, esdevenimientos naturals, a sobén humanos. eventos naturals, y a ormino, ye lo ser humano.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Un tornado ye un cilindro chiratorio d'aire a baixa presión que succiona enta adintro y alto l'aire a lo suyo alredol.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Producen fuertes aireras (a ormino con secuencias de 100-200 millas/hora) y pueden devantar obchectos pesaus en l'aire, levando-se los mientres lo tornado se desplaza.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Prencipian como envasadors que baixan d'as boiras de tronada y se transforman en tornados cuan dentran en contacto con a tierra.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Los furnidors de RPV, (rez privaus virtuals) personals son la opción ideyal pa privar la censura politica y lo geofiltrau d'IP comercial.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Son superiors a los servidors proxy per cuantos motivos: redirichen tot lo transidot d'Internet y no nomás los http.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Per un regular, ofreixen mayor amplura de banda y millor calidat de servicio. Son encriptaus y, gracias a ixo, ye mas complicau hackear-los.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Las empresas de comunicación mienten repetidament sobre la suya finalidat, asegurando que sirve pa «aprevenir la piratería».
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: En efecto, los codigos de rechión no tienen efecto en garra momento sobre las copias ilegals; una copia bit a bit d'un disco se reproduce sin problemas en os diferents dispositivos que l'orichinal.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: L'obchectivo amagau que ixas companyías tienen ye ganar mas control sobre los suyos mercaus; se trata de fer circular los diners.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Como las gritadas s'enrotan per medio d'Internet, no fa falta recorrer a una companyía de telefono ubicada an que vusté vive u en o destín ta an que viacha.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Tampoco no fa falta obtener un numero local d'o puesto an que vive; puede obtener una connexión a Internet per satelite en as rechions mas inhospitas de de Chicken, en Alaska, y triar un numero que sinyale que vusté ye plazau en a soliada Arizona.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: A ormino, ye menister crompar un numero global diferent que permita que le truquen dende telefonos PSTN. L'orichen d'o numero telefonico marca la diferencia pa qui le truca.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Aplicacions de traducción instantanias: son las que pueden chenerar, de manera automatica, traduccions de segmentos completos de texto d'un idioma ta unatro.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Entre esta mena d'aplicacions, podemos trobar-ne belunas que mesmo puede traducir ta idiomas extranchers los textos de cartels u atros obchectos d'o mundo real si l'usuario enfoca lo suyo telefono intelichent enta ixes obchectos.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Los motors de traducción han millorau muitismo y agora, con frecuencia, ufren traduccions prou correctas (y muit rarament conteniu sin sentiu); manimenos, cal tener una mica de precaución, ya que encara ye posible que fallen.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Una d'as principals aplicacions en esta categoría ye Google Translate, que puede fer la traducción sin connexión si se descargan los datos de l'idioma con que se treballará.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Posiblement, lo modo mas simple y convenient de navegar estando difuera d'o suyo país ye instalar aplicacions de navegación GPS en o suyo telefono intelichent.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Se puede cabidar diners mercando nuevos mapas pa GPS, un dispositivo GPS independient, u tamién logando-ne uno en cualsequier achencia de loguero d'autos.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Si no cuenta con una connexión de datos pa lo suyo telefono u si ye difuera de cobertura, puede tener un rendimiento limitau u puede no funcionar.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: En as botigas de cada cantonada i hai una enorme y confusa variedat de tarchetas de telefonía prepagadas que se pueden fer servir en telefonos publicos u comuns.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Encara que cuasi totas las tarchetas son buenas pa gritar a cualsequier puesto, belunas ofreixen tarifas de gritada favorables a grupos de países especificos.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Per un regular, se puede acceder a estes servicios per medio d'un numero telefonico gratuito con o cual ye posible comunicar-se dende la mayoría d'os telefonos, sin coste.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Las reglas d'a fotografía regular resultan tamién d'aplicación a la gravación de videos, posiblement, mesmo mas.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Si ye vedau prener una fotografía de bella cosa, alavez ni sisquiera caldría pensar en fer-ne un video.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Si s'emplega un dron, s'ha de verificar antes qué puede gravar-se y qué permisos u licencias extra fan falta.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Encara que sía legal en a suya rechión, no gosa estar una buena ideya fer volar un dron alredol d'un aeropuerto u per alto d'una multitut.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Actualment, los viaches en avión no se gosan reservan dreitament con l'aerolinia sin antis mirar y acomparar los precios.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: De cabo ta cuan, un mesmo vuelo puede tener precios bien diferents en diferents replegadors de contenius, per lo cual mereixe la pena acomparar los resultaus de busqueda y navegar en o puesto web d'a propia empresa antes de fer la reserva.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Encara que talment no necesites un visau pa visitas curtas ta bel destín si viachas como turista u per negocios, viachar ta ixes mesmos puestos como estudiant internacional per un regular implica una estacha mas larga que una visita ocasional de carácter turistico.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Per un regular, pa quedar-se en cualsequier país estranchero per un largo periodo de tiempo caldrá obtener un visau per anticipau.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Los visaus d'estudiants gosan exichir requisitos y procedimientos de solicitut diferents d'os visaus normals de turismo u negocios.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: En a mayor parte d'os países te exichirán una carta d'ufierta feita per la institución an que tiengas intención d'estudiar y, amás, contrimostrar que tiens los fondos pa mantener-te, a lo menos, lo primer anyo d'o curso.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Compreba-lo en a institución y en a oficina d'immigración d'o destín an que pretendes estudiar, pa conoixer en detalle los requisitos.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: De no estar que sías diplomatico, tener un treballo en o estranchero implica que habrás de declarar l'impuesto sobre la renta en o tuyo país de residencia.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: L'impuesto sobre la renta ye organizau de forma diferent en os distintos estaus y las taxas impositivas y las categorías cambian muito entre países.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: I hai estaus federals, como los Estaus Unius y Canadá, an que l'impuesto sobre la renta riche tanto a nivel federal como local. Como consecuencia, las taxas y categorías pueden estar diferents seguntes la rechión.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Encara que no gosa haber-ie control d'immigración, ye nomás una formalidat, cuan tornes ta lo tuyo país d'orichen, lo control duanero puede estar un estorbo.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Asegura-te de tener claro qué articlos se pueden levar y cuáls no. Amás, declara cualsequier  bien que sobrepase los limites legals.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: La manera mas fácil d'encomenzar en o negocio d'a escritura de viaches ye millorar las tuyas aptituz en una pachina web de blogs de viaches consolidada.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Malas que t'haigas familiarizau con o formateyo y la edición en a web, puez estar presto pa disenyar lo tuyo propio puesto web.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Treballar como voluntario mientres se viacha ye una forma extraordinaria de marcar la diferencia, pero l'obchectivo no ye nomás lo de donar.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Vivir y estar voluntario en un país estranchero ye una manera sobrebuena de plegar a conoixer una cultura distinta, personas nuevas, aprender sobre tu mesmo, tener un sentiu de perspectiva y, mesmo, adquirir habilidaz nuevas.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Tamién puet estar una buena manera d'estirar lo presupuesto y permitir una estacha mas larga, ya que muitos treballos voluntarios son a birolla y cama, y beluns pagan una chicota remuneración.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Las rotas navegables rusas estioron emplegadas per los vikingos pa arribar ta la Mar Negra y ta la Mar Caspia. Encara ye posible emplegar partes d'estas vías. Consulte si cal contar con autorizacions especials, lo cual ye una posibilidat, y podrían estar difícils d'obtener.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: L'Oceano Artico ye ligau a la Mar Baltica a traviés d'a Canal Mar Blanca-Baltica, per medio d'os lagos Onega y Ladoga y a Sant Petersburgo, mayoritariament per ríos y lagos.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Gracias a que lo lago Onega tamién s'une con o Volga, se puede acceder a él dende la mar Caspia, pasando per Rusia.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Puez estar seguro que cuan plegues ta lo puerto, tot será prou obvio. Conoixerás a atros autoestopistas de barco, que compartirán la suya información con tu.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: La tuya fayena será, mas que mas, penchar anuncios ofreixendo la tuya aduya, recorrer los muelles, acercar a las personas que limpian los yates, prebar de fer contacto con os mariners en a tabierna, etc.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Mira de charrar con tanta chent como sía posible. Dimpués d'un tiempo, toz te conoixerán y te darán indicacions sobre qué barco ye buscando chent.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Ha de triar cudiadosament la suya alianza aeria de viachero frecuent.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Tot y que podría pensar que lo mas lochico ye unir-se a la companyía aeria con que mas viacha, ha de saber que los beneficios ufiertos gosan estar diferents y que, de cabo ta cuan, los puntos de viachero pueden atorgar-le mas beneficios en unatra aerolinia d'a mesma alianza.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Companyías aerias tals como Emirates, Etihad, Qatar y Turkish Airlines han aumentau amplament los suyos vuelos ta Africa y ofreixen connexions ta muitas d'as prencipals ciudaz d'o continent, a millor precio que atras empresas europeas.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Dende l'anyo 2014, Turkish Airlines tien vuelos a 39 destins en 30 países d'Africa.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Si le vaga mientres lo viache, acompare la cotización d'a suya tarifa total pa Africa con una tarifa pa viachiar alredol d'o mundo.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: No s'olbide d'incluyir las expensas adicionals, las taxas de salida, lo transporte terrestre, etc. pa toz los puestos que visite difuera d'Africa.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Si quiere viachar alredol d'o mundo circumscribindo-se a l'hemisferio sud, se reducirán las suyas opcions de vuelos y destins pus escaseyan las rotas transoceanicas.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Garra alianza aeria abraca lo cruce d'os tres oceanos en l'hemisferio sud (y SkyTeam no'n cubre garra).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Manimenos, Star Alliance lo cubre tot fueras d'a zona este d'o Pacifico Sud dende Santiago de Chile dica Tahití, zona que corresponde a los vuelos de LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Si quiere evitar lo Pacifico Sud y lo limite ueste de Sudamerica, tien atras opcions amás d'este vuelo (veyer debaixo).
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: En 1994, la zona de Nagorno-Karabaj, d'etnia armenia, en Azerbaichán, se lanzó a la luita cuentra los azeríes.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Con l'emparo d'Armenia, se formó una nueva republica, encara que no ye una nación establida. Ni sisquiera cuenta con a reconoixencia oficial d'o gubierno armenio.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Los vinclos entre Armenia y Azerbaichán siguen veyendo-se afectaus per las diferencias d'indoli diplomatica que chiran alredol d'esta rechión.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Lo Distrito d'a Canal (en holandés, Grachtengordel), en Ámsterdam, ye lo popular barrio d'o sieglo XVII que se desplega alredol de Binnenstad.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Lo distrito completo estió declarau Patrimonio Mundial per la Unesco, a causa d'a suya valura historica y cultural unica, y los precios d'as suyas propiedaz son d'os mas elevaus d'o país.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre (cinco tierras) abraca los chicoz lugars costers de Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza y Monterosso, que se troban en Liguria, Italia.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Fan parte d'a Lista d'o Patrimonio d'a Humanidat d'a Unesco.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Con o paso d'os sieglos, las personas han construyiu con cudiau plataformas en paisaches irregulars y empinaus, mesmo en as cinglas con vistas ta lo mar.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Lo suyo encanto se debe, en parte, a la falta de desenrollo corporativo visible. I hai camins, trens y barcos que unen las aldeyas y los vehíclos no i pueden acceder dende l'exterior.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: I hai sutils diferencias entre las variants d'o francés charradas en Belchica y Suiza y lo que se fa servir en Francia; manimenos, la suya similitut ye suficient pa que sían mutuament intelichibles.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: En particular, lo sistema numerico dos territorios francofonos de Belchica y Suiza tienen chicotas peculiaridaz que difieren d'o francés que se charra en Francia y la pronuncia de cualques parolas ye lucherament diferent.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Manimenos, toz los belgas y suizos de fabla francesa habrán aprendiu francés estándard en o colechio, per tanto, podrían comprender-lo, mesmo si les charra emplegando lo sistema de numeración d'o francés estándard.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: En muitos puestos d'o mundo, saludar con a man ye un cenyo amistoso que significa «ola».
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Manimenos, en Malasia, a lo menos entre qui viven en arias rurals, significa «viene ta aquí», semellant a lo dido indiz que se dobla sinyalando enta lo propio cuerpo, un cenyo que s'emplega en bels países d'Occident; nomás se i ha d'emplegar con ixa finalidat.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: De manera semellant, un viachero britanico que visite Espanya podría confundir un cenyo de despedida que consiste en orientar la palma d'a man enta qui la muestra (en cuenta d'enta la persona a qui se saluda) como un cenyo pa tornar.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Los luengaches auxiliars son idiomas artificials u construyius que se crean con a finalidat de facilitar la comunicación entre pueblos que, si no, tendrían problemas pa comunicar-se.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Se diferencian d'as luengas vehiculars, que son las naturals u organicas que, per bel motivo, se fan dominants como ferramienta de comunicación entre parladors d'atros idiomas.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Con a calor diurna, ye posible que los turistas veigan miraches que cheneran la ilusión de veyer augua, u atras cosas.
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Estes pueden estar periglosos si lo viachero sigue lo mirache, lo cual fará que desaprofite enerchía preciosa y l'augua restant.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Dica los desiertos mas calidos pueden tornar-se estrimadament fredos de nueiz. Si no tien ropa d'abrigo, tien un risgo real de sufrir d'hipotermia.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Si decide de fer una gambada per la selva tropical, habrá de parar cuenta d'os mosquins, mas que mas de verano.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Mesmo si ye conducindo per la selva subtropical y ubre las puertas nomás bels segundos pa dentrar en o vehíclo, ixo ye prou pa que los mosquins i puyen con vusté.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: La gripe aviar, clamada mas formalment influenza aviar, puede afectar a aus y mamifers.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Encara que s'han rechistrau menos de mil casos en personas, beluns d'estes tenioron un resultau fatal.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Si bien cuasi toz los afectaus teneban contacto en os suyos treballos con aus de corral, tamién puede haber bel risgo pa los observadors d'aus.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: En Noruega son tipicos los fiordos y vals empinaus que, de sopetón, ubren paso a una meseta elevada, mas u menos homochenia.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Se gosa clamar vidde a estas mesetas, termen que significa espacio amplio y ubierto sin árbols; ye decir, extensión ilimitada.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Ye común que en Rogaland y Agder se les clame hei, que quiere decir yermo sin árbols, a ormino cubierto de bruecos.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Los glaciars no son immóbils, sino que fluyen montanya ta abaixo, lo cual orichina crepas u ralleras que podrían quedar amagadas per puents de nieu.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Podrían enfondar-se los muros y los teitos d'as espelungas de chelo, y zarrar-se las crepas.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Immensos bloques s'esbalzan y cayen d'os cantos d'os glaciars y, a vegadas, blincan u redolan mas luent d'o canto.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: En as estacions de montanya d'a India, la temporada alta de turistas, per un regular, plega en a suya fuga de verano.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: De totas maneras, la suya belleza y encanto d'hibierno son especials, con buena cosa d'estacions de montanya an que nieva a-saber-lo, fendo posible la practica d'esportes como lo esquí y taula de nieu.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Las aerolinias que encara ofreixen tarifas de duelo no son guaires y descuentan tasament la valor d'os viaches funerarios de zaguera hora.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Las companyías aerias que las ofreixen son Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa, pa vuelos que encomienzan en os Estaus Unius u Canadá, y WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: En toz los casos, ha de fer la reserva per telefono y de forma directa con l'aerolinia.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
